Reeking Corpse.name: Reeking Corpse
Reeking Corpse.description:
The [[lookup @name lowercase]] emits an aura of toxic rot in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=Tfu1rsSgcfDUjJcp]]-foot Emanation.

Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=Tfu1rsSgcfDUjJcp]], any creature that starts its turn in the Emanation.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage.

Save.name: Save
Save.condition: Creature starts its turn in the Emanation

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] makes two [[/item Cleaver]] attacks and one [[/item Crush]] attack. It can replace any attack with a [[/item Throw Flesh]] attack.

Crush.name: Crush
Crush.description: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition (escape DC [[lookup @check.dc.value activity=PTD4UFW8HUU8fbd4]]) from one of two arms. While Grappled, the target has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition.

Grappled.name: Grappled
Grappled.description: If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is &Reference[grappled apply=false] by the creature and can use its action to escape. Until this grapple ends, the target is &Reference[restrained apply=false]{restrained}.

Throw Flesh.name: Throw Flesh
Throw Flesh.description: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition.

Consume Life.name: Consume Life
Consume Life.description:
Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=1Hy8CdhpwQlLxDPq]], [[lookup @target.affects.special activity=1Hy8CdhpwQlLxDPq]] by the [[lookup @name lowercase]].

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage. The target’s Hit Point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the abomination regains Hit Points equal to that amount.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Aku’mai makes as many [[/item Bite]] attacks as it has heads.

Caustic Bile.name: Caustic Bile
Caustic Bile.description:
Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=is5PVusr83d90p9l]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=is5PVusr83d90p9l]]-foot-radius [[lookup @target.template.type capitalize activity=is5PVusr83d90p9l]] centered on a point Aku’mai can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=is5PVusr83d90p9l]] feet.

Failure: [[/damage average activity=is5PVusr83d90p9l]] damage, and [[/damage average activity=IJqgEgJahs3ha0OP]] at the end of its next turn.

Success: Half the initial damage only.

Quake Cavern.name: Quake Cavern
Quake Cavern.description:
Aku’mai causes the earth to quake and rocks to fall from above.

Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=xfcbIRVZti5gOcaG]], each creature within [[lookup @target.template.size activity=xfcbIRVZti5gOcaG]] feet of Aku’mai.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition.

Success: Half damage only.

Failure or Success: Aku’mai can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

Mythic Actions.name: Mythic Actions
Mythic Actions.description: If Aku’mai’s [[/item Tearing the Void]] has activated in the last hour, it can use one of the options below as a Legendary Action. The first time Tearing the Void activates, Aku’mai gains access to [[/item Void Body]]; the second time, it gains access to [[/item Song of Ny’alotha]].

Void Body.name: Void Body
Void Body.description:
Aku’mai’s body extrudes a phantasmal tentacle of its true void form.

Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=4iGTKb0DoVWhlQFZ]], one creature Aku’mai can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=4iGTKb0DoVWhlQFZ]] feet.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target gains 1 level of &Reference[Exhaustion apply=false].

Song of Ny’alotha.name: Song of Ny’alotha
Song of Ny’alotha.description:
Aku’mai wails an otherworldly song.

Wisdom Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=gFgIrYZTwW4pX0Tr]], one creature Aku’mai can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=gFgIrYZTwW4pX0Tr]] feet.

Failure: The target has the &Reference[Unconscious apply=false] condition until the end of its next turn, which ends early if it takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it.

Failure or Success: Aku’mai can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

Foundry Note

Remove the applied Unconscious active effect manually if the early end condition occurs.

Hold Breath.name: Hold Breath
Hold Breath.description: Aku’mai can hold its breath for 1 hour.

Reactive Heads.name: Reactive Heads
Reactive Heads.description: For each head Aku’mai has beyond one, it gets an extra Reaction that can be used only for Opportunity Attacks.

Tearing the Void.name: Tearing the Void
Tearing the Void.description:
Aku’mai has three heads. If it would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, its current Hit Point total instead resets to 149 Hit Points, it recharges its Caustic Bile, it regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance, and one of its remaining heads dies.

Additionally, it can now use one of the options in “Mythic Actions” for 1 hour. Award the characters an additional 3,900 XP for defeating Aku’mai after the first time its Tearing the Void activates and an additional 3,900 XP after the second time (11,700 XP total).

Foundry Note

This activity only spends a Tearing the Void use. Manually update Aku’mai’s HP, Caustic Bile, and Legendary Resistance. Use its remaining Tearing the Void uses as the number of extra Opportunity Attack reactions; add 1 for its current heads and Bite attacks. Mythic access and its duration aren’t automated.

Legendary Resistance.name: Legendary Resistance
Legendary Resistance.description: If Aku’mai fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Alleria makes four attacks, using [[/item Void Dagger]] or [[/item Windrunner’s Bow]] in any combination.

Grasp of Emptiness.name: Grasp of Emptiness
Grasp of Emptiness.description:
Intelligence Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=jWwdRGMhTJneSRKH]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=jWwdRGMhTJneSRKH]]-foot-radius [[lookup @target.template.type capitalize activity=jWwdRGMhTJneSRKH]] centered on a point Alleria can see within 120 feet.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage. Until the end of the target’s next turn, the target’s Speed is halved; the target can’t take Reactions; and it can take either an action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both.

Success: Half damage only.

Half Speed.name: Half Speed
Half Speed.description: Your speed is halved until the end of your next turn.

Void Stealth.name: Void Stealth
Void Stealth.description:
While in Dim Light or Darkness, Alleria can teleport up to [[lookup @teleport.value activity=auHpV3odJmCfUhjB]] feet to an unoccupied space she can see that is also in Dim Light or Darkness.

She then has the &Reference[Invisible apply=false] condition until the start of her next turn.

Teleport.name: Teleport
Teleport.condition: Alleria is in Dim Light or Darkness

Invisible.name: Invisible
Invisible.description: Alleria has the &Reference[Invisible apply=false] condition until the start of her next turn.

Spatial Rift.name: Spatial Rift
Spatial Rift.description:
Trigger: Alleria is hit by an attack roll.

Response: Alleria halves the damage (round down) she takes from that attack and then teleports to an unoccupied space she can see within 30 feet.

utility.condition: Alleria is hit by an attack roll

Whispers of the Void.name: Whispers of the Void
Whispers of the Void.description:
Alleria emanates an aura in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=GZrSX1bCCuCTyeWS]]-foot Emanation while she doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.

Intelligence Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=GZrSX1bCCuCTyeWS]], any enemy that starts its turn in the aura.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Frightened apply=false] condition until the start of its next turn.

save.condition: Enemy starts its turn in the Emanation

Frightened.name: Frightened
Frightened.description: The &Reference[Frightened apply=false] condition until the start of its next turn.

Legendary Resistance.name: Legendary Resistance
Legendary Resistance.description: If Alleria fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Alzzin makes two [[/item Fel Claw]] attacks. He can replace one attack with a use of [[/item Enervation]] and the other with a use of [[/item Wither]].

Enervation.name: Enervation
Enervation.description:
Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=iO4e3oAxXl33ItTO]], one creature within [[lookup @range.value activity=iO4e3oAxXl33ItTO]] feet.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage. If the target can cast spells, it can’t use level 1 spell slots until the end of its next turn.

Foundry Note

Apply Enervated after a failed save only if the target can cast spells. Until the effect expires, do not allow that target to spend a level 1 spell slot.

Enervated.name: Enervated
Enervated.description: You can’t use level 1 spell slots until the end of your next turn.

Wither.name: Wither
Wither.description:
Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=sPQlcoeLCOeJI82m]], one creature within [[lookup @range.value activity=sPQlcoeLCOeJI82m]] feet.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target has Disadvantage on Strength-based D20 Tests and subtracts 1d8 from its damage rolls until the end of its next turn.

Fel Inferno.name: Fel Inferno
Fel Inferno.description:
Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=bwM7NpThymYJAZxy]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=bwM7NpThymYJAZxy]]-foot Emanation originating from Alzzin.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage.

Success: Half damage.

Failure or Success: Alzzin can’t use this action again until the start of his next turn.

Mythic Actions.name: Mythic Actions
Mythic Actions.description: If Alzzin’s Fel Wildshape has activated in the last hour, he can use one of the options below as a Legendary Action. The first time Fel Wildshape activates, Alzzin gains access to Wrath of Mardum; the second time, he gains access to Alacrity of Xoroth.

Wrath of Mardum.name: Wrath of Mardum
Wrath of Mardum.description:
Strength Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=KEKiDJivRdz1mRqy]], one creature within [[lookup @range.value activity=KEKiDJivRdz1mRqy]] feet.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target is pushed 20 feet straight away from Alzzin and drops one object of its choice that it’s holding in the space it was pushed out of. For 1 minute, the object is wreathed in green flames and any creature holding the object has Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws.

Foundry Note

Move the failed target and choose the dropped object manually. Track the object’s one-minute duration from the failed save. Use the Apply Green Flames activity on its current holder, removing or transferring the effect when the object changes hands while preserving the original expiration time.

Apply Green Flames.name: Apply Green Flames
Apply Green Flames.target: Creature currently holding the wreathed object

Wreathed Green Flames.name: Wreathed Green Flames
Wreathed Green Flames.description: While you hold the object wreathed in green flames, you have Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws.

Alacrity of Xoroth.name: Alacrity of Xoroth
Alacrity of Xoroth.description:
Alzzin moves up to 60 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks and can move through the spaces of Medium or smaller creatures. Each time Alzzin enters a creature’s space for the first time during this move, that target is subjected to the following effect.

Strength Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=aA6niNBhll4oU8oP]].

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target’s Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

Foundry Note

Move Alzzin’s token manually. The first time he enters each creature’s space during that move, target that creature and use Alacrity Collision once.

Alacrity Collision.name: Alacrity Collision
Alacrity Collision.range: creature whose space Alzzin entered during this move

Expend Use & Move.name: Expend Use & Move
Expend Use & Move.description: Alzzin moves up to 60 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks and can move through the spaces of Medium or smaller creatures.

Slowed.name: Slowed
Slowed.description: The target’s Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

Fel Wildshape.name: Fel Wildshape
Fel Wildshape.description:
If Alzzin would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, his current Hit Point total instead resets to 200 Hit Points, and he regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance. Additionally, he can now use one of the options in “Mythic Actions” for 1 hour.

The first time he uses it, he transforms into a Huge bear; award the characters an additional 10,000 XP for defeating him in this form.

The second time he uses it, he transforms into a Large wolf; award the characters an additional 10,000 XP for defeating him in this form (30,000 XP total).

Except for his size and Mythic Actions, his game statistics are unchanged when he shape-shifts.

Foundry Note

Select Bear Form for the first activation and Wolf Form for the second. After each activation, set Alzzin’s current HP to 200, reset his Legendary Resistance spent value to 0, and start a one-hour timer for the newly unlocked Mythic Action.

The No Form option consumes an Item Use by default. To restore Alzzin’s normal form without spending a use, remove the applied form effect from his Effects tab.

Legendary Resistance.name: Legendary Resistance
Legendary Resistance.description: If Alzzin fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The ancient makes three attacks, using [[/item Slam]] or [[/item Hurl Lightning]] in any combination.

Hurl Lightning.name: Hurl Lightning
Hurl Lightning.description: Ranged Attack Roll: [[/attack]], range 500 ft. Hit: [[/damage average]] damage.

Nature’s Fury.name: Nature’s Fury
Nature’s Fury.description:
Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=8T893BMJYmBeydAF]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=8T893BMJYmBeydAF]]-foot-radius, [[lookup @target.template.height activity=8T893BMJYmBeydAF]]-foot-high [[lookup @target.template.type capitalize activity=8T893BMJYmBeydAF]] originating from a point the ancient can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=8T893BMJYmBeydAF]] feet.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false] and &Reference[Deafened apply=false] conditions until the start of the ancient’s next turn.

Success: Half damage only.

Blinded & Deafened.name: Blinded & Deafened
Blinded & Deafened.description: The &Reference[Blinded apply=false] and &Reference[Deafened apply=false] conditions until the start of the attacking creature's next turn.

Siege Monster.name: Siege Monster
Siege Monster.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] deals double damage to objects and structures.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Anduin makes four attacks, using [[/item Shalamayne]] or [[/item Holy Fire]] in any combination.

Radiant Volley.name: Radiant Volley
Radiant Volley.description:
Anduin unleashes a wave of radiant energy in a 60-foot Emanation, restoring 45 ([[/r 7d12]]) Hit Points to himself or an ally he can see in the Emanation.

Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 19, each enemy in the Emanation.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage.

Success: Half damage.

Divine Aid.name: Divine Aid
Divine Aid.description: Anduin casts [[/item .J42QV76XDxXLzOHz]]{Bless}, [[/item .YbDOMRD4Sp97cIEh]]{Dispel Magic}, or [[/item .4lMiIqdFUuSdFi5h]]{Greater Restoration}, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

Power Word: Shield.name: Power Word: Shield
Power Word: Shield.description:
Trigger: Anduin is hit by an attack roll.

Response: Anduin gains 25 Temporary Hit Points.

heal.condition: Anduin is hit by an attack roll

Plate Armor.name: Plate Armor
Plate Armor.description: Plate consists of shaped, interlocking metal plates to cover the entire body. A suit of plate includes gauntlets, heavy leather boots, a visored helmet, and thick layers of padding underneath the armor. Buckles and straps distribute the weight over the body.

Holy Symbol.name: Holy Symbol
Holy Symbol.description:
A Holy Symbol takes one of the forms in the Holy Symbol table and is bejeweled or painted to channel divine magic. A Cleric or Paladin can use a Holy Symbol as a Spellcasting Focus.

The table indicates whether a Holy Symbol needs to be held, worn, or borne on fabric (such as a tabard or banner) or a Shield.

Holy Symbols
SymbolWeightCost
@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbhsyAmuletworn]{Amulet} (worn or held)1 lb.5 GP
@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbhsyEmblemborn]{Emblem} (borne on fabric or a Shield)—5 GP
@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbhsyReliquaryh]{Reliquary} (held)2 lb.5 GP

Legendary Resistance.name: Legendary Resistance
Legendary Resistance.description: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]] fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Bless.name: Bless
Bless.description:
You bless up to three creatures within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target adds 1d4 to the attack roll or save.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

Blessed.name: Blessed
Blessed.description: Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target adds 1d4 to the attack roll or save.

Dispel Magic.name: Dispel Magic
Dispel Magic.description:
Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any ongoing spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends. For each ongoing spell of level 4 or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (DC 10 plus that spell’s level). On a successful check, the spell ends.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You automatically end a spell on the target if the spell’s level is equal to or less than the level of the spell slot you use.

Greater Restoration.name: Greater Restoration
Greater Restoration.description:
You touch a creature and magically remove one of the following effects from it:

  • 1 &Reference[Exhaustion] level
  • The &Reference[Charmed] or &Reference[Petrified] condition
  • A curse, including the target’s Attunement to a cursed magic item
  • Any reduction to one of the target’s ability scores
  • Any reduction to the target’s Hit Point maximum

Spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
Spellcasting.description:
Anduin casts one of the following spells, using [[lookup @attributes.spell.abilityLabel]] as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]):

At Will: [[/item .R2tApdJ5t3JT0vzK]]{Light}, [[/item .8qLfQAgCQRtED7wp]]{Thaumaturgy}

2/Day Each: [[/item .U2qSB9GGmnMi7naj]]{Daylight}, [[/item .Q61200zHc7sGdNuC]]{Dispel Evil and Good}, [[/item .iyiHOwPNsLdPV5vi]]{Zone of Truth}

1/Day Each: [[/item .xwoxbPXki8mypnvT]]{Raise Dead}, [[/item .GSeatBBEpFZfNVn3]]{Sunburst}

Thaumaturgy.name: Thaumaturgy
Thaumaturgy.description:
You manifest a minor wonder within range. You create one of the effects below within range. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its 1-minute effects active at a time.

Altered Eyes. You alter the appearance of your eyes for 1 minute.

Booming Voice. Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute. For the duration, you have Advantage on [[/check ability=cha skill=itm]] checks.

Fire Play. You cause flames to flicker, brighten, dim, or change color for 1 minute.

Invisible Hand. You instantaneously cause an unlocked door or window to fly open or slam shut.

Phantom Sound. You create an instantaneous sound that originates from a point of your choice within range, such as a rumble of thunder, the cry of a raven, or ominous whispers.

Tremors. You cause harmless tremors in the ground for 1 minute.

Booming Voice.name: Booming Voice
Booming Voice.description: Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute. For the duration, you have Advantage on [[/check ability=cha skill=itm]] checks.

Daylight.name: Daylight
Daylight.description:
For the duration, sunlight spreads from a point within range and fills a 60-foot-radius Sphere. The sunlight's area is Bright Light and sheds Dim Light for an additional 60 feet.

Alternatively, you cast the spell on an object that isn't being worn or carried, causing the sunlight to fill a 60-foot Emanation originating from that object. Covering that object with something opaque, such as a bowl or helm, blocks the sunlight.

If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of Darkness created by a spell of level 3 or lower, that other spell is dispelled.

Dispel Evil and Good.name: Dispel Evil and Good
Dispel Evil and Good.description:
For the duration, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. You can end the spell early by using either of the following special functions.

Break Enchantment. As a Magic action, you touch a creature that is possessed by or has the &Reference[Charmed] or &Reference[Frightened] condition from one or more creatures of the types above. The target is no longer possessed, Charmed, or Frightened by such creatures.

Dismissal. As a Magic action, you target one creature you can see within 5 feet of you that has one of the creature types above. The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be sent back to its home plane if it isn't there already. If they aren't on their home plane, Undead are sent to the Shadowfell, and Fey are sent to the Feywild.

Dismissal.name: Dismissal
Dismissal.target: Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend, or Undead

Break Enchantment.name: Break Enchantment
Break Enchantment.target: Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend, or Undead

Dispelling Evil and Good.name: Dispelling Evil and Good
Dispelling Evil and Good.description: For the duration, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. You can end the spell early by using either of the following special functions: Break Enchantment or Dismissal.

Light.name: Light
Light.description:
You touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.

Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.

Sunburst.name: Sunburst
Sunburst.description:
Brilliant sunlight flashes in a 60-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature in the Sphere makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 12d6 Radiant damage and has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false] condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.

A creature Blinded by this spell makes another [[/save ability=con dc=@attributes.spell.dc format=long]] at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

This spell dispels &Reference[Darkness] in its area that was created by any spell.

Blinded.name: Blinded
Blinded.description: A creature &Reference[Blinded apply=false] by this spell makes another [[/save ability=con format=long]] at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Raise Dead.name: Raise Dead
Raise Dead.description:
With a touch, you revive a dead creature if it has been dead no longer than 10 days and it wasn't Undead when it died.

The creature returns to life with 1 Hit Point. This spell also neutralizes any poisons that affected the creature at the time of death.

This spell closes all mortal wounds, but it doesn't restore missing body parts. If the creature is lacking body parts or organs integral for its survival—its head, for instance—the spell automatically fails.

Coming back from the dead is an ordeal. The target takes a −4 penalty to D20 Tests. Every time the target finishes a Long Rest, the penalty is reduced by 1 until it becomes 0.

Resurrection Sickness (Day 1).name: Resurrection Sickness (Day 1)
Resurrection Sickness (Day 1).description: Coming back from the dead is an ordeal. The target takes a −4 penalty to D20 Tests. Every time the target finishes a Long Rest, the penalty is reduced by 1 until it becomes 0.

Resurrection Sickness (Day 2).name: Resurrection Sickness (Day 2)
Resurrection Sickness (Day 2).description: Coming back from the dead is an ordeal. The target takes a −4 penalty to D20 Tests. Every time the target finishes a Long Rest, the penalty is reduced by 1 until it becomes 0.

Resurrection Sickness (Day 4).name: Resurrection Sickness (Day 4)
Resurrection Sickness (Day 4).description: Coming back from the dead is an ordeal. The target takes a −4 penalty to D20 Tests. Every time the target finishes a Long Rest, the penalty is reduced by 1 until it becomes 0.

Resurrection Sickness (Day 3).name: Resurrection Sickness (Day 3)
Resurrection Sickness (Day 3).description: Coming back from the dead is an ordeal. The target takes a −4 penalty to D20 Tests. Every time the target finishes a Long Rest, the penalty is reduced by 1 until it becomes 0.

Zone of Truth.name: Zone of Truth
Zone of Truth.description:
You create a magical zone that guards against deception in a 15-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range. Until the spell ends, a creature that enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a creature can't speak a deliberate lie while in the radius. You know whether a creature succeeds or fails on this save.

An affected creature is aware of the spell and can avoid answering questions to which it would normally respond with a lie. Such a creature can be evasive yet must be truthful.

Cannot Lie.name: Cannot Lie
Cannot Lie.description:
On a failed save, a creature can’t speak a deliberate lie while in the radius. You know whether a creature succeeds or fails on this save.

An affected creature is aware of the spell and can avoid answering questions to which it would normally respond with a lie. Such a creature can be evasive yet must be truthful.

Shalamayne.name: Shalamayne
Shalamayne.description:
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]].

When dragon magic split King Varian Wrynn into two versions of himself, one of his selves wielded the night elven blade Shalla’tor, while the other wielded the night elven blade Ellemayne. Varian eventually merged his twin selves back into one whole. In doing so, he inadvertently fused the blades into a new weapon called Shalamayne.

The Jailer, one of the rulers of the Shadowlands, once stole and reforged Shalamayne into a mourneblade called Kingsmourne. But Varian’s son, Anduin Wrynn, later restored Shalamayne to its rightful form. Anduin is the sword’s last known wielder.

Magic Weapon. You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It deals an extra 2d12 Force damage on a hit.

Dual Mastery. If you have the Weapon Mastery feature and choose Greatsword as one of your mastered weapons, you can use both the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.content.JournalEntry.phbEquipment0000.JournalEntryPage.EOW6yQHLKlXre3jn#graze]{Graze} and @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.content.JournalEntry.phbEquipment0000.JournalEntryPage.EOW6yQHLKlXre3jn#sap]{Sap} mastery properties at once while wielding Shalamayne.

Splitting and Reuniting the Sword. While holding Shalamayne, you can take a Magic action to end your Attunement to the weapon and split it into two magic swords: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.items.Item.wowShallatorRTIC]{Shalla’tor }and @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.items.Item.wowEllemaynecX2Z]{Ellemayne}. Each is a +3 Longsword with the Finesse and Light properties. A creature who holds both swords can take a Magic action to rejoin them into Shalamayne, attuning to the weapon instantly.

Random Properties. Shalamayne has the following random properties:

  • @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.tables.RollTable.dmgMinorBenefici]{2 minor beneficial properties}

  • @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.tables.RollTable.dmgMajorBenefici]{1 major beneficial property}

Destroying Shalamayne. One can destroy Shalamayne by splitting it into Shalla’tor and Ellemayne, then burying one or both swords at the roots of a World Tree in the Emerald Dream. After one year, the buried swords dissolve into the soil.

Anti-Spell Field.name: Anti-Spell Field
Anti-Spell Field.description: Creatures other than Doan within 10 feet of the tome can’t take the &Reference[Magic] action.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Anub’arak makes two attacks using [[/item Icy Claw]] or [[/item Crypt Bolt]] in any combination.

Crypt Bolt.name: Crypt Bolt
Crypt Bolt.description: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]], and the target’s Speed decreases by 20 feet until the start of Anub’arak’s next turn.

Earth Spike.name: Earth Spike
Earth Spike.description:
Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=uUKsRSBOT4Q4cWU2]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=uUKsRSBOT4Q4cWU2]]-foot-radius, [[lookup @target.template.height activity=uUKsRSBOT4Q4cWU2]]-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point on an earthen surface within [[lookup @range.value activity=uUKsRSBOT4Q4cWU2]] feet of Anub’arak.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition.

Submerge.name: Submerge
Submerge.description:
Trigger: Anub’arak becomes Bloodied or takes damage while Bloodied.

Response: Anub’arak moves up to his Burrow Speed into the ground. While underground, he has &Reference[Total Cover] from attacks and other effects outside the earth, and he regains 30 Hit Points at the start of each of his turns. He emerges on his turn when he reaches his Hit Point maximum or if all his allies within 120 feet of him are killed.

Foundry Note

After using Expend Use, apply Total Cover to Anub’arak and move his token manually. Track his underground position and resolve cover from outside the earth manually. Use Underground Recovery at each turn start while he is underground. Remove Total Cover when he emerges.

Total Cover.name: Total Cover
Total Cover.description: Anub’arak is underground and has Total Cover; track cover and emergence manually.

Swarm Aura.name: Swarm Aura
Swarm Aura.description:
Anub’arak emanates a swarm of undead insects in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=1N79YzVaQ6pj3Nwi]]-foot Emanation while he doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition. At the end of each of Anub’arak’s turns, each creature in the Emanation takes [[/damage average]] damage.

Foundry Note

At Anub’arak’s turn end, use Damage if he is not Incapacitated. Target every creature currently in the Emanation and apply the damage. Remove the measurement template afterward.

Damage.name: Damage
Damage.condition: At the end of each of Anub’arak’s turns

Undead Fortitude.name: Undead Fortitude
Undead Fortitude.description: If damage reduces Anub’arak to 0 Hit Points, he makes a Constitution saving throw (DC 5 plus the damage taken) unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a successful save, Anub’arak drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

Legendary Resistance.name: Legendary Resistance
Legendary Resistance.description: If Anub’arak fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

Spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
Spellcasting.description:
Doan casts one of the following spells, using [[lookup @attributes.spell.abilityLabel]] as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]):

At Will: [[/item .GTz6qYddnElHSzEF]]{Detect Thoughts}, [[/item .fb4sG5akmZuDZ4pN]]{Mage Armor}, [[/item .DtqnI4TMVOsoP1Ep]]{Mage Hand}, [[/item .Erj3ZhW9Lj8t66wL]]{Prestidigitation}

2/Day: [[/item .ehOiIL3mec1t0ETT]]{Polymorph}

1/Day: [[/item .Eu1zbmmgJnU3ABrx]]{Prismatic Spray}

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Doan makes three [[/item Arcane Explosion]] attacks and uses [[/item Spellcasting]] to cast Polymorph if available.

Detonate.name: Detonate
Detonate.description:
Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=R4437q8rIs9J0EYo]], each creature of Doan’s choice within a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=R4437q8rIs9J0EYo]]-foot Emanation originating from him.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage.

Success: Half damage.

Misty Step.name: Misty Step
Misty Step.description: Doan teleports to an unoccupied space he can see within 30 feet.

Anti-Spell Tome.name: Anti-Spell Tome
Anti-Spell Tome.description:
Doan summons a floating tome in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of himself. The spellbook is an object that has AC 20, HP 25, Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage, and a Fly Speed of 20 feet, and it automatically succeeds on saving throws. Creatures other than Doan within 10 feet of the tome can’t take the Magic action.

Foundry Note

Do not roll saving throws for the tome; treat them as successes.

Arcane Bubble.name: Arcane Bubble
Arcane Bubble.description:
If Doan would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, his current Hit Point total instead resets to 165 Hit Points, he has Immunity to all damage until the start of his next turn, and he regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance.

Additionally, he can now use the [[/item Detonate]] action and the [[/item Anti-Spell Tome]] Bonus Action for 1 hour. Award the characters an additional 5,900 XP (11,800 XP total) for defeating Doan after his Arcane Bubble activates.

Foundry Note

Use this Activity instead of applying the triggering damage. Set Doan's HP to 165, apply both linked effects, and confirm Legendary Resistance Spent is 0. Use Arcane Bubble Empowerment as the one-hour tracker for Detonate and Anti-Spell Tome. If Doan is later defeated, award 11,800 XP total.

Arcane Bubble.name: Arcane Bubble
Arcane Bubble.condition: Doan would be reduced to 0 Hit Points

Magic Resistance.name: Magic Resistance
Magic Resistance.description: Doan has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Mage Armor.name: Mage Armor
Mage Armor.description: You touch a willing creature who isn’t wearing armor. Until the spell ends, the target’s base AC becomes 13 plus its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends early if the target dons armor.

Mage Armor.name: Mage Armor
Mage Armor.description: The target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier.

Polymorph.name: Polymorph
Polymorph.description:
You attempt to transform a creature that you can see within range into a Beast. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or shape-shift into a Beast form for the duration. That form can be any Beast you choose that has a Challenge Rating equal to or less than the target’s (or the target’s level if it doesn’t have a Challenge Rating). The target’s game statistics are replaced by the stat block of the chosen Beast, but the target retains its alignment, personality, creature type, Hit Points, and Hit Point Dice. See appendix B for a sample of Beast stat blocks.

The target gains a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points of the Beast form. These Temporary Hit Points vanish if any remain when the spell ends. The spell ends early on the target if it has no Temporary Hit Points left.

The target is limited in the actions it can perform by the anatomy of its new form, and it can’t speak or cast spells.

The target’s gear melds into the new form. The creature can’t use or otherwise benefit from any of that equipment.

Prismatic Spray.name: Prismatic Spray
Prismatic Spray.description:
Eight rays of light flash from you in a 60-foot Cone. Each creature in the Cone makes a Dexterity saving throw. For each target, roll 1d8 to determine which color ray affects it, consulting the Prismatic Rays table.

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.tables.RollTable.phbPrismaticRays rollable=true caption=false]{Prismatic Rays}

Petrifying (Indigo).name: Petrifying (Indigo)
Petrifying (Indigo).description: The target has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition and makes a [[/save ability=con format=long]] at the end of each of its turns. If it successfully saves three times, the condition ends. If it fails three times, it has the &Reference[Petrified] condition until it is freed by an effect like the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplGreaterRes]{Greater Restoration} spell. The successes and failures needn’t be consecutive; keep track of both until the target collects three of a kind.

Teleporting (Violet).name: Teleporting (Violet)
Teleporting (Violet).description: The target has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false] condition and makes a [[/save ability=wis format=long]] at the start of your next turn. On a successful save, the condition ends. On a failed save, the condition ends, and the creature teleports to another plane of existence (DM’s choice).

Prestidigitation.name: Prestidigitation
Prestidigitation.description:
You create a magical effect within range. Choose the effect from the options below. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time.

Sensory Effect. You create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as a shower of sparks, a puff of wind, faint musical notes, or an odd odor.

Fire Play. You instantaneously light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire.

Clean or Soil. You instantaneously clean or soil an object no larger than 1 cubic foot.

Minor Sensation. You chill, warm, or flavor up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving material for 1 hour.

Magic Mark. You make a color, a small mark, or a symbol appear on an object or a surface for 1 hour.

Minor Creation. You create a nonmagical trinket or an illusory image that can fit in your hand. It lasts until the end of your next turn. A trinket can deal no damage and has no monetary worth.

Detect Thoughts.name: Detect Thoughts
Detect Thoughts.description:
You activate one of the effects below. Until the spell ends, you can activate either effect as a Magic action on your later turns.

Sense Thoughts. You sense the presence of thoughts within 30 feet of yourself that belong to creatures that know languages or are telepathic. You don’t read the thoughts, but you know that a thinking creature is present.

The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

Read Thoughts. Target one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself or one creature within 30 feet of yourself that you detected with the Sense Thoughts option. You learn what is most on the target’s mind right now. If the target doesn’t know any languages and isn’t telepathic, you learn nothing.

As a Magic action on your next turn, you can try to probe deeper into the target’s mind. If you probe deeper, the target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you discern the target’s reasoning, emotions, and something that looms large in its mind (such as a worry, love, or hate). On a successful save, the spell ends. Either way, the target knows that you are probing into its mind, and until you shift your attention away from the target’s mind, the target can take an action on its turn to make an [[/check ability=int skill=arc dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] check against your spell save DC, ending the spell on a success.

Mage Hand.name: Mage Hand
Mage Hand.description:
A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.

When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.

As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.

The hand can’t attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

Legendary Resistance.name: Legendary Resistance
Legendary Resistance.description: If Doan fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

Staff.name: Staff
Staff.description:
An @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbagArcaneFocus]{Arcane Focus} is bejeweled or carved to channel arcane magic. A Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard can use such an item as a Spellcasting Focus.

This item also functions as a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepQuartersta]{Quarterstaff}

Foundry Note

This item has been configured with the additional properties of a Quarterstaff.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Ashbury makes two [[/item Pain Blast]] attacks.

Asphyxiate.name: Asphyxiate
Asphyxiate.description:
Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=jR82HRk4NUcPKcVu]], each creature of Ashbury’s choice within [[lookup @range.value activity=jR82HRk4NUcPKcVu]] feet.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage.

Success: Half damage.

Wracking Pain.name: Wracking Pain
Wracking Pain.description:
Wisdom Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=LwpSU2Xx7MEUCZiq]], one creature Ashbury can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=LwpSU2Xx7MEUCZiq]] feet.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage.

Mythic Actions.name: Mythic Actions
Mythic Actions.description: If Baron Ashbury’s Dark Archangel Form has activated in the last hour, he can use the option below as a Legendary Action.

Calamity.name: Calamity
Calamity.description:
Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=8b28uhwRgCNtjJS2]], each creature of Ashbury’s choice in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=8b28uhwRgCNtjJS2]]-foot Emanation originating from him.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage.

Failure or Success: Ashbury can’t take this action again until the start of his next turn.

Dark Archangel Form.name: Dark Archangel Form
Dark Archangel Form.description:
If Ashbury would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, his current Hit Point total instead resets to 82 Hit Points. He also gains a Fly Speed of 30 feet.

Additionally, he can now use the option in “Mythic Actions” for 1 hour. Award the characters an additional 1,100 XP (2,200 XP total) for defeating Ashbury after his Dark Archangel Form activates.

Foundry Note

An Active Effect can be enabled in the Effects tab to add a Fly speed to the actor sheet. Track Calamity's one-hour availability manually.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Silverlaine makes one [[/item Object Slam]] attack and uses [[/item Telekinetic Thrust]].

Telekinetic Thrust.name: Telekinetic Thrust
Telekinetic Thrust.description:
Strength Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=Xg9HY5Tf7H7ghgrF]], one creature Silverlaine can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=Xg9HY5Tf7H7ghgrF]] feet.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target is pushed up to 30 feet straight away from Silverlaine.

Cursed Veil.name: Cursed Veil
Cursed Veil.description:
Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=sC6uUHOizpeYmdqM]], one creature Silverlaine can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=sC6uUHOizpeYmdqM]] feet.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage.

Odo’s Blinding Shadows.name: Odo’s Blinding Shadows
Odo’s Blinding Shadows.description:
The spirit of Odo the Blindwatcher hurls shadows at a foe.

Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=FMyBw1jnWFyh9ldh]], one creature Silverlaine can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=FMyBw1jnWFyh9ldh]] feet.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false] condition until the end of Silverlaine’s next turn.

Failure or Success: Silverlaine can’t take this action again until the start of his next turn.

Rethilgore’s Soul Drain.name: Rethilgore’s Soul Drain
Rethilgore’s Soul Drain.description:
The spirit of Rethilgore feasts on an enemy’s soul.

Charisma Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=ft85Zm9QSaIfIl7I]], one creature Silverlaine can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=ft85Zm9QSaIfIl7I]] feet.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition until the end of Silverlaine’s next turn.

Failure or Success: Silverlaine can’t take this action again until the start of his next turn.

Incorporeal Movement.name: Incorporeal Movement
Incorporeal Movement.description: Silverlaine can move through other creatures and objects as if they were &Reference[Difficult Terrain]. He takes [[/damage 1d10 Force average]] damage if he ends his turn inside an object.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: You make two [[/item Mangle]] attacks.

Mangle.name: Mangle
Mangle.description: Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier Slashing damage. This damage increases by 1d8 when you reach Druid levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

Frenzied Regeneration.name: Frenzied Regeneration
Frenzied Regeneration.description: You expend a level 1+ spell slot and gain Temporary Hit Points equal to five times the spell slot level.

Growl.name: Growl
Growl.description:
Trigger: A creature you can see attacks a target other than you that is within 5 feet of you.

Response: You impose Disadvantage on the triggering attack roll and all other attack rolls against the target until the start of your next turn if you remain within 5 feet of the target.

Use.name: Use
Use.condition: A creature you can see attacks a target other than you that is within 5 feet of you.

Spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
Spellcasting.description:
The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using [[lookup @attributes.spell.abilityLabel]] as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]):

At Will: [[/item .eGcJjbDoovbZ0qXs]]{Heat Metal} (level 8 version), [[/item .9VG7uZVVHCgqvwMw]]{Shapechange} (Beast or Humanoid form only, no Temporary Hit Points gained from the spell, and no Concentration or Temporary Hit Points required to maintain the spell), [[/item .hAdKoNCNqKDUfX6t]]{Stone Shape}

1/Day: [[/item .TjDBBS0mz9aXrymi]]{Incendiary Cloud}

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The dragon makes three [[/item Rend]] attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of [[/item Spellcasting]] to cast [[/item .eGcJjbDoovbZ0qXs]]{Heat Metal} (level 8 version).

Magma Breath.name: Magma Breath
Magma Breath.description:
Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=ME18w5oY1WAukwtM]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=ME18w5oY1WAukwtM]]-foot [[lookup @target.template.type capitalize activity=ME18w5oY1WAukwtM]].

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage.

Success: Half damage.

Pyroclastic Eruption.name: Pyroclastic Eruption
Pyroclastic Eruption.description:
Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=evhbIh6XnOT76HuA]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=evhbIh6XnOT76HuA]]-foot radius, [[lookup @target.template.height activity=evhbIh6XnOT76HuA]]-foot-high [[lookup @target.template.type capitalize activity=evhbIh6XnOT76HuA]] centered on a point on the ground the dragon can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=evhbIh6XnOT76HuA]] feet.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition.

Success: Half damage only.

Failure or Success: The dragon can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn, and the ground in the affected area becomes molten for 1 minute. While molten, the ground is &Reference[Difficult Terrain], and any creature that ends its turn there starts burning.

Prone.name: Prone
Prone.description: The target is knocked &Reference[prone apply=false] and can use half of their movement on their turn to stand up.

Legendary Resistance.name: Legendary Resistance
Legendary Resistance.description: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]] fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Pounce.name: Pounce
Pounce.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one [[/item Rend]] attack.

Heat Metal.name: Heat Metal
Heat Metal.description:
Choose a manufactured metal object, such as a metal weapon or a suit of Heavy or Medium metal armor, that you can see within range. You cause the object to glow red-hot. Any creature in physical contact with the object takes 2d8 Fire damage when you cast the spell. Until the spell ends, you can take a Bonus Action on each of your later turns to deal this damage again if the object is within range.

If a creature is holding or wearing the object and takes the damage from it, the creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or drop the object if it can. If it doesn’t drop the object, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of your next turn.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 2.

Heated Metal.name: Heated Metal
Heated Metal.description: If a creature is holding or wearing the object and takes the damage from it, The creature must succeed on a [[/save ability=con format=long]] or drop the object if it can. If it doesn’t drop the object, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of your next turn.

Shapechange.name: Shapechange
Shapechange.description:
You shape-shift into a Beast or Humanoid for the duration or until you take a Magic action to shape-shift into a different eligible form. The new form must have a Challenge Rating no higher than your Challenge Rating, and you must have seen the sort of creature before.

Your game statistics are replaced by the stat block of the chosen form, but you retain your creature type; alignment; personality; Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; Hit Points; Hit Point Dice; proficiencies; and ability to communicate. If you have the Spellcasting feature, you retain it too.

Upon shape-shifting, you determine whether your equipment drops to the ground or changes in size and shape to fit the new form while you’re in it.

This version of the spell grants no Temporary Hit Points and requires no Concentration or Temporary Hit Points to maintain.

Stone Shape.name: Stone Shape
Stone Shape.description: You touch a stone object of Medium size or smaller or a section of stone no more than 5 feet in any dimension and form it into any shape you like. For example, you could shape a large rock into a weapon, statue, or coffer, or you could make a small passage through a wall that is 5 feet thick. You could also shape a stone door or its frame to seal the door shut. The object you create can have up to two hinges and a latch, but finer mechanical detail isn’t possible.

Incendiary Cloud.name: Incendiary Cloud
Incendiary Cloud.description:
A swirling cloud of embers and smoke fills a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range. The cloud’s area is &Reference[HeavilyObscured]. It lasts for the duration or until a strong wind (like that created by @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplGustofWind]{Gust of Wind}) disperses it.

When the cloud appears, each creature in it makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d8 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature must also make this save when the Sphere moves into its space and when it enters the Sphere or ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

The cloud moves 10 feet away from you in a direction you choose at the start of each of your turns.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack

Multiattack.description: Thalnos makes three [[/item Shadow Bolt]] attacks.

Divine Flames.description: Thalnos casts [[/item .Qxfo5mIOB07k3s1l]]{Flame Strike}, using [[lookup @attributes.spell.abilityLabel]] as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]).

Spirit Gale.name: Spirit Gale
Spirit Gale.description:
Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=R8yQnTOywHYgeotK]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=R8yQnTOywHYgeotK]]-foot-radius [[lookup @target.template.type capitalize activity=R8yQnTOywHYgeotK]] centered on a point Thalnos can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=R8yQnTOywHYgeotK]] feet of him.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition until the start of Thalnos’s next turn.

Success: Half damage only.

Protective Magic.name: Protective Magic
Protective Magic.description: Thalnos casts [[/item .rS6LOTjlFWOCJVGf]]{Counterspell} or [[/item .fVppsw2JSPD5THoX]]{Shield} in response to the spell’s trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Divine Flames.

Flame Strike.name: Flame Strike
Flame Strike.description:
A vertical column of brilliant fire roars down from above. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point within range makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d6 Fire damage and 5d6 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The Fire damage and the Radiant damage increase by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 5.

Shield.name: Shield
Shield.description: An imperceptible barrier of magical force protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplMagicMissi]{Magic Missile}.

Imperceptible Barrier.name: Imperceptible Barrier
Imperceptible Barrier.description: Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from Magic Missile.

Counterspell.name: Counterspell
Counterspell.description: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell. The creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the spell dissipates with no effect, and the action, Bonus Action, or Reaction used to cast it is wasted. If that spell was cast with a spell slot, the slot isn’t expended.

Staff.name: Staff
Staff.description:
An @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbagArcaneFocus]{Arcane Focus} is bejeweled or carved to channel arcane magic. A Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard can use such an item as a Spellcasting Focus.

This item also functions as a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepQuartersta]{Quarterstaff}

Foundry Note

This item has been configured with the additional properties of a Quarterstaff.

Wall of Ice.name: Wall of Ice
Wall of Ice.description:
You create a wall of ice on a solid surface within range. You can form it into a hemispherical dome or a globe with a radius of up to 10 feet, or you can shape a flat surface made up of ten 10-foot-square panels. Each panel must be contiguous with another panel. In any form, the wall is 1 foot thick and lasts for the duration.

If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (you choose which side) and makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d6 Cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

The wall is an object that can be damaged and thus breached. It has AC 12 and 30 Hit Points per 10-foot section, and it has Immunity to Cold, Poison, and Psychic damage and Vulnerability to Fire damage. Reducing a 10-foot section of wall to 0 Hit Points destroys it and leaves behind a sheet of frigid air in the space the wall occupied.

A creature moving through the sheet of frigid air for the first time on a turn makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 5d6 Cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage the wall deals when it appears increases by 2d6 and the damage from passing through the sheet of frigid air increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 6.

Frigid Air.name: Frigid Air
Frigid Air.condition: creature moves through the wall for the first time on a turn

Major Image.name: Major Image
Major Image.description:
You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 20-foot Cube. The image appears at a spot that you can see within range and lasts for the duration. It seems real, including sounds, smells, and temperature appropriate to the thing depicted, but it can't deal damage or cause conditions.

If you are within range of the illusion, you can take a Magic action to cause the image to move to any other spot within range. As the image changes location, you can alter its appearance so that its movements appear natural for the image. For example, if you create an image of a creature and move it, you can alter the image so that it appears to be walking. Similarly, you can cause the illusion to make different sounds at different times, even making it carry on a conversation, for example.

Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, for things can pass through it. A creature that takes a Study action to examine the image can determine that it is an illusion with a successful [[/check ability=int skill=inv dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image, and its other sensory qualities become faint to the creature.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The spell lasts until dispelled, without requiring Concentration, if cast with a level 4+ spell slot.

Scrying.name: Scrying
Scrying.description:
You can see and hear a creature you choose that is on the same plane of existence as you. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw, which is modified (see the tables below) by how well you know the target and the sort of physical connection you have to it. The target doesn't know what it is making the save against, only that it feels uneasy.

Your Knowledge of the Target Is …Save Modifier
Secondhand (heard of the target)+5
Firsthand (met the target)+0
Extensive (know the target well)−5
You Have the Target's …Save Modifier
Picture or other likeness−2
Garment or other possession−4
Body part, lock of hair, or bit of nail−10

On a successful save, the target isn't affected, and you can't use this spell on it again for 24 hours.

On a failed save, the spell creates an Invisible, intangible sensor within 10 feet of the target. You can see and hear through the sensor as if you were there. The sensor moves with the target, remaining within 10 feet of it for the duration. If something can see the sensor, it appears as a luminous orb about the size of your fist.

Instead of targeting a creature, you can target a location you have seen. When you do so, the sensor appears at that location and doesn't move.
Scrying.target: creature on same plane of existence or a location you have seen

Ice Storm.description:

Hailstones turn ground in the Cylinder into &Reference[DifficultTerrain] until the end of your next turn.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The Bludgeoning damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 4.

Dispel Magic.name: Dispel Magic

Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any ongoing spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends. Shapechange.name: Shapechange
Shapechange.description:
You shape-shift into a Beast or Humanoid for the duration or until you take a Magic action to shape-shift into a different eligible form. The new form must have a Challenge Rating no higher than your Challenge Rating, and you must have seen the sort of creature before.

Your game statistics are replaced by the stat block of the chosen form, but you retain your creature type; alignment; personality; Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; Hit Points; Hit Point Dice; proficiencies; and ability to communicate. If you have the Spellcasting feature, you retain it too.

Upon shape-shifting, you determine whether your equipment drops to the ground or changes in size and shape to fit the new form while you’re in it.

This version of the spell grants no Temporary Hit Points and requires no Concentration or Temporary Hit Points to maintain.

Legend Lore.name: Legend Lore
Legend Lore.description:
Name or describe a famous person, place, or object. The spell brings to your mind a brief summary of the significant lore about that famous thing, as described by the DM.

The lore might consist of important details, amusing revelations, or even secret lore that has never been widely known. The more information you already know about the thing, the more precise and detailed the information you receive is. That information is accurate but might be couched in figurative language or poetry, as determined by the DM.

If the famous thing you chose isn’t actually famous, you hear sad musical notes played on a trombone, and the spell fails.

Magic Mouth.name: Magic Mouth
Magic Mouth.description:
You implant a message within an object in range—a message that is uttered when a trigger condition is met. Choose an object that you can see and that isn’t being worn or carried by another creature. Then speak the message, which must be 25 words or fewer, though it can be delivered over as long as 10 minutes. Finally, determine the circumstance that will trigger the spell to deliver your message.

When that trigger occurs, a magical mouth appears on the object and recites the message in your voice and at the same volume you spoke. If the object you chose has a mouth or something that looks like a mouth (for example, the mouth of a statue), the magical mouth appears there, so the words appear to come from the object’s mouth. When you cast this spell, you can have the spell end after it delivers its message, or it can remain and repeat its message whenever the trigger occurs.

The trigger can be as general or as detailed as you like, though it must be based on visual or audible conditions that occur within 30 feet of the object. For example, you could instruct the mouth to speak when any creature moves within 30 feet of the object or when a silver bell rings within 30 feet of it.

Sending.name: Sending
Sending.description:
You send a short message of 25 words or fewer to a creature you have met or a creature described to you by someone who has met it. The target hears the message in its mind, recognizes you as the sender if it knows you, and can answer in a like manner immediately. The spell enables targets to understand the meaning of your message.

You can send the message across any distance and even to other planes of existence, but if the target is on a different plane than you, there is a 5 percent chance that the message doesn’t arrive. You know if the delivery fails.

Upon receiving your message, a creature can block your ability to reach it again with this spell for 8 hours. If you try to send another message during that time, you learn that you are blocked, and the spell fails.

Slow.name: Slow
Slow.description:
You alter time around up to six creatures of your choice in a 40-foot Cube within range. Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be affected by this spell for the duration.

An affected target’s Speed is halved, it takes a −2 penalty to AC and Dexterity saving throws, and it can’t take Reactions. On its turns, it can take either an action or a Bonus Action, not both, and it can make only one attack if it takes the Attack action. If it casts a spell with a Somatic component, there is a [[/r 1d100cs>25#Spell cast successfully on 1]]{25 percent} chance the spell fails as a result of the target making the spell’s gestures too slowly.

An affected target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.

Time Stop.name: Time Stop
Time Stop.description:
You briefly stop the flow of time for everyone but yourself. No time passes for other creatures, while you take 1d4 + 1 turns in a row, during which you can use actions and move as normal.

This spell ends if one of the actions you use during this period, or any effects that you create during it, affects a creature other than you or an object being worn or carried by someone other than you. In addition, the spell ends if you move to a place more than 1,000 feet from the location where you cast it.

Pounce.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one [[/item Rend]] attack.

If you cast the spell more than once before finishing a Long Rest, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that you get no answer.

Slow.name: Slow
Slow.description:
You alter time around up to six creatures of your choice in a 40-foot Cube within range. Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be affected by this spell for the duration.

An affected target's Speed is halved, it takes a −2 penalty to AC and Dexterity saving throws, and it can't take Reactions. On its turns, it can take either an action or a Bonus Action, not both, and it can make only one attack if it takes the Attack action. If it casts a spell with a Somatic component, there is a [[/r 1d100cs>25#Spell cast successfully on 1]]{25 percent} chance the spell fails as a result of the target making the spell's gestures too slowly.

An affected target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.

Foundry Note

The inline roll above will return 1 if it succeeded or 0 if it failed.

Slowed.name: Slowed
Slowed.description:
An affected target’s Speed is halved, it takes a −2 penalty to AC and Dexterity saving throws, and it can’t take Reactions. On its turns, it can take either an action or a Bonus Action, not both, and it can make only one attack if it takes the Attack action. If it casts a spell with a Somatic component, there is a [[/r 1d100cs>25#Spell cast successfully on 1]]{25 percent} chance the spell fails as a result of the target making the spell’s gestures too slowly.

An affected target repeats the [[/save ability=wis]] save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.

Legend Lore.name: Legend Lore
Legend Lore.description:
Name or describe a famous person, place, or object. The spell brings to your mind a brief summary of the significant lore about that famous thing, as described by the DM.

The lore might consist of important details, amusing revelations, or even secret lore that has never been widely known. The more information you already know about the thing, the more precise and detailed the information you receive is. That information is accurate but might be couched in figurative language or poetry, as determined by the DM.

If the famous thing you chose isn't actually famous, you hear sad musical notes played on a trombone, and the spell fails.

Scrying.name: Scrying
Scrying.description:
You can see and hear a creature you choose that is on the same plane of existence as you. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw, which is modified (see the tables below) by how well you know the target and the sort of physical connection you have to it. The target doesn't know what it is making the save against, only that it feels uneasy.

Your Knowledge of the Target Is …Save Modifier
Secondhand (heard of the target)+5
Firsthand (met the target)+0
Extensive (know the target well)−5
You Have the Target's …Save Modifier
Picture or other likeness−2
Garment or other possession−4
Body part, lock of hair, or bit of nail−10

On a successful save, the target isn't affected, and you can't use this spell on it again for 24 hours.

On a failed save, the spell creates an Invisible, intangible sensor within 10 feet of the target. You can see and hear through the sensor as if you were there. The sensor moves with the target, remaining within 10 feet of it for the duration. If something can see the sensor, it appears as a luminous orb about the size of your fist.

Instead of targeting a creature, you can target a location you have seen. When you do so, the sensor appears at that location and doesn't move.

Divination.name: Divination
Divination.description:
This spell puts you in contact with a god or a god's servants. You ask one question about a specific goal, event, or activity to occur within 7 days. The DM offers a truthful reply, which might be a short phrase or cryptic rhyme. The spell doesn't account for circumstances that might change the answer, such as the casting of other spells.

If you cast the spell more than once before finishing a Long Rest, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that you get no answer.

Injury Poison

Primal Wrath.description:
You expend a level 1+ spell slot and slash nearby enemies.

Dexterity Saving Throw: DC equals your spell save DC, each creature of your choice within a 5-foot Emanation originating from you.

Failure: 2d6 Slashing damage per spell slot level expended plus your Wisdom modifier.

Prowl.name: Prowl
Prowl.description: You move up to half your Speed without provoking &Reference[Opportunity Attacks]. At the end of this movement, you can take the &Reference[Hide] action.

Pounce.name: Pounce
Pounce.description:
Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d10 + your Wisdom modifier Slashing damage. This damage increases by 1d10 when you reach Druid levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).

If you had Advantage on the attack roll, the target takes an extra 1d6 Slashing damage and, if it is Large or smaller, has the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition. The extra damage increases by 1d6 when you reach Druid levels 6 (2d6), 9 (3d6), 12 (4d6), 15 (5d6), and 18 (6d6).

Damage at Advantage.name: Damage at Advantage
Damage at Advantage.description: Use after a Pounce attack made with Advantage hits. Apply the linked Prone effect only if the target is Large or smaller. If Pounce was a Critical Hit, roll this Activity as Critical.

Wild Shape Ability Scores.name: Wild Shape Ability Scores
Wild Shape Ability Scores.description: Makes the transformed character’s Strength and Dexterity equal to their Wisdom score.

Cho’Rush casts one of the following spells, using [[lookup @attributes.spell.abilityLabel]] as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]):

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Cho’Rush makes two [[/item Lightning Staff]] attacks, then uses [[/item Spellcasting]] to cast [[/item .ZvHyjsyr60I3JHxA]]{Fear}.

Adviser’s Aid.name: Adviser’s Aid
Adviser’s Aid.description: Cho’Rush casts [[/item .i7r4rPWfScKcy9kT]]{Bless}, [[/item .MA8iS8hK9ShKB4gm]]{Dispel Magic}, [[/item .GgkV0sbVTtxIZv5B]]{Healing Word} (level 4 version), or [[/item .kiGJ4ayPYJ072Mh0]]{Lesser Restoration}, using the same Spellcasting ability as Spellcasting and requiring no spell components.

Chain Lightning.name: Chain Lightning
Chain Lightning.description:
You launch a lightning bolt toward a target you can see within range. Three bolts then leap from that target to as many as three other targets of your choice, each of which must be within 30 feet of the first target. A target can be a creature or an object and can be targeted by only one of the bolts.

Each target makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d8 Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. One additional bolt leaps from the first target to another target for each spell slot level above 6.
Chain Lightning.target: secondary targets must be within 30 feet of initial target

Warding Bond.name: Warding Bond
Warding Bond.description:
You touch another creature that is willing and create a mystic connection between you and the target until the spell ends. While the target is within 60 feet of you, it gains a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws, and it has &Reference[damageresistance]{Resistance} to all damage. Also, each time it takes damage, you take the same amount of damage.

The spell ends if you drop to 0 Hit Points or if you and the target become separated by more than 60 feet. It also ends if the spell is cast again on either of the connected creatures.

Bonded.name: Bonded
Bonded.description:
While the target is within 60 feet of you, it gains a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws, and it has Resistance to all damage. Also, each time it takes damage, you take the same amount of damage.

The spell ends if you drop to 0 Hit Points or if you and the target become separated by more than 60 feet. It also ends if the spell is cast again on either of the connected creatures.

Zone of Truth.name: Zone of Truth
Zone of Truth.description:
You create a magical zone that guards against deception in a 15-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range. Until the spell ends, a creature that enters the spell’s area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a creature can’t speak a deliberate lie while in the radius. You know whether a creature succeeds or fails on this save.

An affected creature is aware of the spell and can avoid answering questions to which it would normally respond with a lie. Such a creature can be evasive yet must be truthful.

Cannot Lie.name: Cannot Lie
Cannot Lie.description:
On a failed save, a creature can’t speak a deliberate lie while in the radius. You know whether a creature succeeds or fails on this save.

An affected creature is aware of the spell and can avoid answering questions to which it would normally respond with a lie. Such a creature can be evasive yet must be truthful.

Fear.name: Fear
Fear.description:
Each creature in a 30-foot Cone must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or drop whatever it is holding and have the &Reference[frightened apply=false] condition for the duration.

A Frightened creature takes the &Reference[dash] action and moves away from you by the safest route on each of its turns unless there is nowhere to move. If the creature ends its turn in a space where it doesn’t have line of sight to you, the creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the spell ends on that creature.

Fear.name: Fear
Fear.description: A &Reference[frightened apply=false] creature takes the &Reference[dash] action and moves away from you by the safest route on each of its turns unless there is nowhere to move. If the creature ends its turn in a space where it doesn’t have line of sight to you, the creature makes a [[/save ability=wis]] saving throw. On a successful save, the spell ends on that creature.

Bless.name: Bless
Bless.description:
You bless up to three creatures within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target adds 1d4 to the attack roll or save.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

Blessed.name: Blessed
Blessed.description: Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target adds 1d4 to the attack roll or save.

Lesser Restoration.name: Lesser Restoration
Lesser Restoration.description: You touch a creature and end one condition on it: &Reference[blinded], &Reference[deafened], &Reference[paralyzed], or &Reference[poisoned].

Healing Word.name: Healing Word
Healing Word.description:
A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains Hit Points equal to 2d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The healing increases by 2d4 for each spell slot level above 1.

Dispel Magic.name: Dispel Magic
Dispel Magic.description:
Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any ongoing spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends. For each ongoing spell of level 4 or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (DC 10 plus that spell’s level). On a successful check, the spell ends.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You automatically end a spell on the target if the spell’s level is equal to or less than the level of the spell slot you use.

Legendary Resistance.name: Legendary Resistance
Legendary Resistance.description: If Cho’Rush fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

Staff.name: Staff
Staff.description:
An @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbagArcaneFocus]{Arcane Focus} is bejeweled or carved to channel arcane magic. A Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard can use such an item as a Spellcasting Focus.

This item also functions as a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepQuartersta]{Quarterstaff}

Foundry Note

This item has been configured with the additional properties of a Quarterstaff.

Life Bond.name: Life Bond
Life Bond.description: When you regain Hit Points from a level 1+ spell, the steed regains the same number of Hit Points if you’re within 5 feet of it.

Otherworldly Slam.description: Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d8 plus the spell’s level of Force damage.

Flyby.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] doesn’t provoke an &Reference[OpportunityAttacks]{Opportunity Attack} when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.

The specters are under Springvale’s control and share his Initiative count but act immediately after him.

Aura of Desecration.name: Aura of Desecration
Aura of Desecration.description:
While he’s in combat, a shadowy, defiling aura surrounds Springvale in a 20-foot Emanation originating from him, provided he doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.

The aura is Difficult Terrain for non-Undead creatures, and a non-Undead creature takes [[/damage average]] damage when it ends its turn in the aura.

Foundry Note

Use Aura Damage for each eligible creature at the end of its turn. Handle the aura's Difficult Terrain manually; the native Region behavior cannot exclude Undead creatures or suspend itself when Springvale leaves combat or becomes Incapacitated.
