Dream Banishment.name: Dream Banishment
Dream Banishment.description:
Charisma Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=gdr7uHcSfGVCJwOq]], one creature the dragon can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=gdr7uHcSfGVCJwOq]] feet.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition and is transported to a harmless demiplane resembling the Emerald Dream until the start of the dragon’s next turn, at which point it reappears in the space it left or the nearest unoccupied space.

Failure or Success: The dragon can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

Incapacitated.name: Incapacitated
Incapacitated.description: The target has the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition and is transported to a harmless demiplane resembling the Emerald Dream.

Emerald Restoration.name: Emerald Restoration
Emerald Restoration.description: The dragon casts [[/item .7PMPR8Xwdd9TQSmw]]{Greater Restoration}, [[/item .EEO0iyFYNlILseMD]]{Lesser Restoration}, or [[/item .8yZe9ubfQfj0WITv]]{Remove Curse}, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

Legendary Resistance.name: Legendary Resistance
Legendary Resistance.description: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]] fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Greater Restoration.name: Greater Restoration
Greater Restoration.description:
You touch a creature and magically remove one of the following effects from it:

  • 1 &Reference[Exhaustion] level
  • The &Reference[Charmed] or &Reference[Petrified] condition
  • A curse, including the target’s Attunement to a cursed magic item
  • Any reduction to one of the target’s ability scores
  • Any reduction to the target’s Hit Point maximum

Lesser Restoration.name: Lesser Restoration
Lesser Restoration.description: You touch a creature and end one condition on it: &Reference[blinded], &Reference[deafened], &Reference[paralyzed], or &Reference[poisoned].

Remove Curse.name: Remove Curse
Remove Curse.description: At your touch, all curses affecting one creature or object end. If the object is a cursed magic item, its curse remains, but the spell breaks its owner’s Attunement to the object so it can be removed or discarded.

Shapechange.name: Shapechange
Shapechange.description:
You shape-shift into a Beast or Humanoid for the duration or until you take a Magic action to shape-shift into a different eligible form. The new form must have a Challenge Rating no higher than your Challenge Rating, and you must have seen the sort of creature before.

Your game statistics are replaced by the stat block of the chosen form, but you retain your creature type; alignment; personality; Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; Hit Points; Hit Point Dice; proficiencies; and ability to communicate. If you have the Spellcasting feature, you retain it too.

Upon shape-shifting, you determine whether your equipment drops to the ground or changes in size and shape to fit the new form while you’re in it.

This version of the spell grants no Temporary Hit Points and requires no Concentration or Temporary Hit Points to maintain.

Sleep.name: Sleep
Sleep.description:
Each creature of your choice in a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the &Reference[incapacitated apply=false] condition until the end of its next turn, at which point it must repeat the save. If the target fails the second save, the target has the &Reference[unconscious] condition for the duration. The spell ends on a target if it takes damage or someone within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake it out of the spell’s effect.

Creatures that don’t sleep, such as elves, or that have Immunity to the Exhaustion condition automatically succeed on saves against this spell.

Sleeping.name: Sleeping
Sleeping.description: The target has the &Reference[incapacitated apply=false] condition until the end of its next turn, at which point it must repeat the save. If the target fails the second save, the target has the &Reference[unconscious] condition for the duration. The spell ends on a target if it takes damage or someone within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake it out of the spell’s effect.

Speak with Plants.name: Speak with Plants
Speak with Plants.description:
You imbue plants in an immobile 30-foot Emanation with limited sentience and animation, giving them the ability to communicate with you and follow your simple commands. You can question plants about events in the spell’s area within the past day, gaining information about creatures that have passed, weather, and other circumstances.

You can also turn &Reference[difficultterrain] caused by plant growth (such as thickets and undergrowth) into ordinary terrain that lasts for the duration. Or you can turn ordinary terrain where plants are present into Difficult Terrain that lasts for the duration.

The spell doesn’t enable plants to uproot themselves and move about, but they can move their branches, tendrils, and stalks for you.

If a Plant creature is in the area, you can communicate with it as if you shared a common language.

Speak with Animals.name: Speak with Animals
Speak with Animals.description:
For the duration, you can comprehend and verbally communicate with Beasts, and you can use any of the Influence action’s skill options with them.

Most Beasts have little to say about topics that don’t pertain to survival or companionship, but at minimum, a Beast can give you information about nearby locations and monsters, including whatever it has perceived within the past day.

Dream.name: Dream
Dream.description:
You target a creature you know on the same plane of existence. You or a willing creature you touch enters a trance state to act as a dream messenger. While in the trance, the messenger is &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] and has a Speed of 0.

If the target is asleep, the messenger appears in the target’s dreams and can converse with the target as long as it remains asleep, through the spell’s duration. The messenger can also shape the dream’s environment, creating landscapes, objects, and other images. The messenger can emerge from the trance at any time, ending the spell. The target recalls the dream perfectly upon waking.

If the target is awake when you cast the spell, the messenger knows it and can either end the trance (and the spell) or wait for the target to sleep, at which point the messenger enters its dreams.

You can make the messenger terrifying to the target. If you do so, the messenger can deliver a message of no more than ten words, and then the target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target gains no benefit from its rest, and it takes 3d6 Psychic damage when it wakes up.

Trance State.name: Trance State
Trance State.description: While in the trance, the messenger is Incapacitated and has a Speed of 0.

Melf's Acid Arrow.name: Melf's Acid Arrow
Melf's Acid Arrow.description:
A shimmering green arrow streaks toward a target within range and bursts in a spray of acid. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 4d4 Acid damage and 2d4 Acid damage at the end of its next turn. On a miss, the arrow splashes the target with acid for half as much of the initial damage only.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage (both initial and later) increases by 1d4 for each spell slot level above 2.

Lingering Acid.name: Lingering Acid
Lingering Acid.description: On a hit, the target takes 4d4 Acid damage and [[/damage 2d4 type=acid]] (plus 1d4 per spell slot level above 2) Acid damage at the end of its next turn.

Pounce.name: Pounce
Pounce.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one [[/item Rend]] attack.

Spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
Spellcasting.description:
The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using [[lookup @attributes.spell.abilityLabel]] as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]):

At Will: [[/item .aUf55N3ccfP9Z5j8]]{Shapechange} (Beast or Humanoid form only, no Temporary Hit Points gained from the spell, and no Concentration or Temporary Hit Points required to maintain the spell), [[/item .2kxKwClQHWJgsoyy]]{Sleep}, [[/item .PmiH0uxdURAcThZZ]]{Speak with Animals}, [[/item .Wj5C6PP9jzEX6LDA]]{Speak with Plants}

2/Day: [[/item .qZKKz1dyKepgIext]]{Dream}

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The dragon makes three [[/item Rend]] attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of [[/item Spellcasting]] to cast [[/item .2kxKwClQHWJgsoyy]]{Sleep}.

Rend.name: Rend
Rend.description: Melee Attack Roll: [[/attack]] to hit, reach 15 ft. Hit: [[/damage average]] damage.

Emerald Gas Breath.name: Emerald Gas Breath
Emerald Gas Breath.description:
Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=FMzMM2Mw5Xo6FlKK]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=FMzMM2Mw5Xo6FlKK]]-foot [[lookup @target.template.type capitalize activity=FMzMM2Mw5Xo6FlKK]].

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage.

Success: Half damage.

Acid Arrow.name: Acid Arrow
Acid Arrow.description: The dragon casts [[/item .BDjRGyJQrpCmVfYC]]{Melf's Acid Arrow}, (level 5 version), using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting (+13 to hit with spell attacks). The dragon can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

Failure or Success: The dragon can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Edwin makes three [[/item Scimitar]] attacks.

Scimitar.name: Scimitar
Scimitar.description:
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]].

If the target is a creature and doesn’t already have a rending wound, it is subjected to the following effect.

Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=uIRE4hOy3ZItytPu]].

Failure: The target receives a rending wound. While wounded, the target loses [[/damage average activity=jYZDQpkfpR5EQsU4]]{7 (2d6)} Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. The wound closes after 1 minute, after a spell restores Hit Points to the target, or after the target or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to stanch the wound and succeeds on a [[/check format=long]].

Foundry Note

After a hit, use Rending Wound Save only if the target has no Rending Wound effect. Apply the effect after a failed save. At each wounded creature’s turn start, use Rending Wound HP Loss and subtract the result directly from its current HP. To stanch the wound, target the creature making the check and use Stanch Wound; remove the effect from the wounded creature on a success. Also remove it when a spell restores HP.

Rending Wound Save.name: Rending Wound Save
Rending Wound Save.condition: After the Scimitar hits a creature that doesn’t already have a Rending Wound effect.

Rending Wound HP Loss.name: Rending Wound HP Loss
Rending Wound HP Loss.condition: At the start of the wounded creature’s turn.

Stanch Wound.name: Stanch Wound
Stanch Wound.range: The wounded creature or a creature within 5 feet of it

Shadowstep.name: Shadowstep
Shadowstep.description:
Edwin teleports to an unoccupied space he can see within 60 feet. If he teleports into a space within 5 feet of a creature, he gains Advantage on his next melee attack roll against it.

Foundry Note

Control Edwin before using the Teleport button, and confirm that the destination is visible and unoccupied. If the placement qualifies for Shadowstep’s attack benefit, select Advantage in the next melee attack’s roll configuration against that creature.

Evasion.name: Evasion
Evasion.description:
If Edwin is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the save and only half damage if he fails. He can’t use this trait if he has the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition.

Foundry Note

In the incoming effect’s damage tray, set Edwin’s multiplier to 0 after a successful Dexterity save or ½ after a failed save. Use the normal damage application while he is Incapacitated.

Ram.name: Ram
Ram.description: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a [[lookup @target.affects.special activity=z58sUDUmqxECJgT3]] creature and the [[lookup @name lowercase]] moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra [[/damage 2d4 bludgeoning average]] damage and has the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The imp makes two [[/item Fel Firebolt]] attacks.

Magic Resistance.name: Magic Resistance
Magic Resistance.description: The imp has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Ritual of J’eevee.name: Ritual of J’eevee
Ritual of J’eevee.description:
Trigger: Pusillin becomes Bloodied but is conscious.

Response: Pusillin summons an Infernal (see chapter 7), which appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of him and remains until killed.

Summon Infernal.name: Summon Infernal
Summon Infernal.condition: Pusillin becomes Bloodied but is conscious.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The felguard makes two attacks, using [[/item Fel Battleaxe]] or [[/item Fel Javelin]] in any combination.

Demonic Restoration.name: Demonic Restoration
Demonic Restoration.description: If the felguard dies outside the Twisting Nether, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body in [[/r 2d4]] weeks, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Twisting Nether.

Fiendish Devotion.name: Fiendish Devotion
Fiendish Devotion.description: The felguard has Advantage on saving throws against the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] and &Reference[Frightened apply=false] conditions.

Pack Tactics.name: Pack Tactics
Pack Tactics.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]'s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The felhound makes one [[/item Bite]] attack and one [[/item Grappling Tentacles]] attack.

Bite.name: Bite

The totem is a Small object with AC 15 and HP 10.

Searing Totem.description:
The furbolg creates a searing totem. When it appears, and at the start of each of the furbolg’s turns until the furbolg dies or the totem is destroyed, the totem launches a globe of fire at a creature of the furbolg’s choice.

The totem is a Small object with AC 15 and HP 10. [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]].

Elementalism.name: Elementalism
Elementalism.description:
You exert control over the elements, creating one of the following effects within range.

Beckon Air. You create a breeze strong enough to ripple cloth, stir dust, rustle leaves, and close open doors and shutters, all in a 5-foot Cube. Doors and shutters being held open by someone or something aren't affected.

Beckon Earth. You create a thin shroud of dust or sand that covers surfaces in a 5-foot-square area, or you cause a single word to appear in your handwriting in a patch of dirt or sand.

Beckon Fire. You create a thin cloud of harmless embers and colored, scented smoke in a 5-foot Cube. You choose the color and scent, and the embers can light candles, torches, or lamps in that area. The smoke's scent lingers for 1 minute.

Beckon Water. You create a spray of cool mist that lightly dampens creatures and objects in a 5-foot Cube. Alternatively, you create 1 cup of clean water either in an open container or on a surface, and the water evaporates in 1 minute.

Sculpt Element. You cause dirt, sand, fire, smoke, mist, or water that can fit in a 1-foot Cube to assume a crude shape (such as that of a creature) for 1 hour.

Beckon Element.name: Beckon Element
Beckon Element.chatFlavor: Fire and water beckoning lasts for 1 minute

Druidcraft.name: Druidcraft
Druidcraft.description:
Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create one of the following effects within range.

Weather Sensor. You create a Tiny, harmless sensory effect that predicts what the weather will be at your location for the next 24 hours. The effect might manifest as a golden orb for clear skies, a cloud for rain, falling snowflakes for snow, and so on. This effect persists for 1 round.

Bloom. You instantly make a flower blossom, a seed pod open, or a leaf bud bloom.

Sensory Effect. You create a harmless sensory effect, such as falling leaves, spectral dancing fairies, a gentle breeze, the sound of an animal, or the faint odor of skunk. The effect must fit in a 5-foot Cube.

Fire Play. You light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a campfire.

Entangle.name: Entangle
Entangle.description:
Grasping plants sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square within range. For the duration, these plants turn the ground in the area into &Reference[difficultterrain]. They disappear when the spell ends.

Each creature (other than you) in the area when you cast the spell must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have the &Reference[restrained apply=false] condition until the spell ends. A Restrained creature can take an action to make a [[/check ability=str skill=ath dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] check against your spell save DC. On a success, it frees itself from the grasping plants and is no longer Restrained by them.

Restrained.name: Restrained
Restrained.description: A Restrained creature can take an action to make a [[/check ability=str skill=ath]] check against your spell save DC. On a success, it frees itself from the grasping plants and is no longer Restrained by them.

Shell Spin.name: Shell Spin
Shell Spin.description:
Ghamoo-Ra moves up to its Speed, then retracts into its shell and spins. Its AC increases to 21 until the end of its next turn, and any creature it’s grappling loses the Grappled condition and lands with the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it.

Foundry Note

Multiattack.description: Gilnid makes two [[/item Searing Mace]] attacks. He can replace one attack with a use of [[/item Spellcasting]].

Repair Prototype.description: Gilnid restores [[/heal average]] to a Construct within 5 feet.

Redirect Attack.name: Redirect Attack
Redirect Attack.description:
Trigger: A creature Gilnid can see makes an attack roll against him.

Response: Gilnid chooses a Small or Medium ally within 5 feet. Gilnid and that ally swap places, and the ally becomes the target of the attack instead.

Foundry Note

Pause the triggering attack before resolving it. Move both tokens manually, clear Gilnid as a target, and target the chosen ally.

utility.condition: A creature Gilnid can see makes an attack roll against him.

Grease.name: Grease
Grease.description:
Nonflammable grease covers the ground in a 10-foot square centered on a point within range and turns it into &Reference[difficultterrain] for the duration.

When the grease appears, each creature standing in its area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the &Reference[prone] condition. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed on that save or fall Prone.

Faerie Fire.name: Faerie Fire
Faerie Fire.description:
Objects in a 20-foot Cube within range are outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice). Each creature in the Cube is also outlined if it fails a Dexterity saving throw. For the duration, objects and affected creatures shed &Reference[dimlight] in a 10-foot radius and can’t benefit from the Invisible condition.

Attack rolls against an affected creature or object have Advantage if the attacker can see it.

Outlined.name: Outlined
Outlined.description:
For the duration, objects and affected creatures shed &Reference[dimlight] in a 10-foot radius and can’t benefit from the Invisible condition.

Attack rolls against an affected creature or object have Advantage if the attacker can see it.

Heat Metal.name: Heat Metal
Heat Metal.description:
Choose a manufactured metal object, such as a metal weapon or a suit of Heavy or Medium metal armor, that you can see within range. You cause the object to glow red-hot. Any creature in physical contact with the object takes 2d8 Fire damage when you cast the spell. Until the spell ends, you can take a Bonus Action on each of your later turns to deal this damage again if the object is within range.

If a creature is holding or wearing the object and takes the damage from it, the creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or drop the object if it can. If it doesn’t drop the object, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of your next turn.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 2.

Heated Metal.name: Heated Metal
Heated Metal.description: If a creature is holding or wearing the object and takes the damage from it, The creature must succeed on a [[/save ability=con format=long]] or drop the object if it can. If it doesn’t drop the object, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of your next turn.

Acid Cloud.description: Hadronox casts @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplCloudkill0], requiring no spell components and using Constitution as the spellcasting ability (save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]). It can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

Pierce Armor.name: Pierce Armor
Pierce Armor.description:
Hadronox makes one [[/item Bite]] attack. If it hits, the target’s armor also takes a −1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10. The penalty can be removed by casting the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplMending000]{Mending} spell on the armor or repairing it with the appropriate Artisan’s Tools during a Short or Long Rest.

Foundry Note

Apply a new Pierced Armor Active Effect each time Pierce Armor hits. Each effect reduces the target’s AC by 1, and the separate effects stack cumulatively. Remove the applicable Pierced Armor effects when the armor is repaired.

Cloudkill.description:
You create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of yellow-green fog centered on a point within range. The fog lasts for the duration or until strong wind (such as the one created by Gust of Wind) disperses it, ending the spell. Its area is Heavily Obscured.

Each creature in the Sphere makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 5d8 Poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature must also make this save when the Sphere moves into its space and when it enters the Sphere or ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

The Sphere moves 10 feet away from you at the start of each of your turns.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 5.
