Restoration.description: Whitemane casts [[/item .ZYGLmRhGjrIGFsMb]]{Lesser Restoration}, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

Scarlet Resurrection.name: Scarlet Resurrection
Scarlet Resurrection.description:
If Whitemane would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, her current Hit Point total instead resets to 130 Hit Points, and she resurrects Scarlet Commander Mograine with all his Hit Points. Both she and Mograine regain any expended uses of Legendary Resistance.

Award the characters an additional 20,000 XP for defeating Mograine and Whitemane (40,000 XP total for both) after her Scarlet Resurrection activates.

Resurrect.name: Resurrect
Resurrect.condition: Whitemane would be reduced to 0 Hit Points

Spirit Guardians.name: Spirit Guardians
Spirit Guardians.description:
Whitemane is surrounded by damned spirits in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=TsLQz7Od89smlNKO]]-foot Emanation while she doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition. The Emanation is &Reference[Difficult Terrain] for her enemies.

Wisdom Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=TsLQz7Od89smlNKO]], any enemy that starts its turn in the Emanation.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage.

Success: Half damage.

Spirit Guardians.name: Spirit Guardians
Spirit Guardians.condition: An enemy starts its turn in the Emanation while Whitemane isn’t Incapacitated

Lesser Restoration.name: Lesser Restoration
Lesser Restoration.description: You touch a creature and end one condition on it: &Reference[blinded], &Reference[deafened], &Reference[paralyzed], or &Reference[poisoned].

Zone of Truth.name: Zone of Truth
Zone of Truth.description:
You create a magical zone that guards against deception in a 15-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range. Until the spell ends, a creature that enters the spell’s area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a creature can’t speak a deliberate lie while in the radius. You know whether a creature succeeds or fails on this save.

An affected creature is aware of the spell and can avoid answering questions to which it would normally respond with a lie. Such a creature can be evasive yet must be truthful.

Cannot Lie.name: Cannot Lie
Cannot Lie.description:
On a failed save, a creature can’t speak a deliberate lie while in the radius. You know whether a creature succeeds or fails on this save.

An affected creature is aware of the spell and can avoid answering questions to which it would normally respond with a lie. Such a creature can be evasive yet must be truthful.

Flame Strike.name: Flame Strike
Flame Strike.description:
A vertical column of brilliant fire roars down from above. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point within range makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d6 Fire damage and 5d6 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The Fire damage and the Radiant damage increase by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 5.

Freedom of Movement.name: Freedom of Movement
Freedom of Movement.description:
You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target’s movement is unaffected by &Reference[DifficultTerrain], and spells and other magical effects can neither reduce the target’s Speed nor cause the target to have the &Reference[Paralyzed apply=false] or &Reference[Restrained apply=false] conditions. The target also has a Swim Speed equal to its Speed.

In addition, the target can spend 5 feet of movement to automatically escape from nonmagical restraints, such as manacles or a creature imposing the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition on it.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4.

Foundry Note

The Active Effect provided by the Cast activity upgrades the character's Swim Speed to a value of "1" to indicate equivalence to (walk) Speed, in addition to the condition immunities. It also automates ignoring all Difficult Terrain.

Dominate Person.name: Dominate Person
Dominate Person.description:
One Humanoid you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] condition for the duration. The target has Advantage on the save if you or your allies are fighting it. Whenever the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

You have a telepathic link with the Charmed target while the two of you are on the same plane of existence. On your turn, you can use this link to issue commands to the target (no action required), such as “Attack that creature,” “Move over there,” or “Fetch that object.” The target does its best to obey on its turn. If it completes an order and doesn’t receive further direction from you, it acts and moves as it likes, focusing on protecting itself.

You can command the target to take a Reaction but must take your own Reaction to do so.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. Your Concentration can last longer with a spell slot of level 6 (up to 10 minutes), 7 (up to 1 hour), or 8+ (up to 8 hours).

Dominated.name: Dominated
Dominated.description: Whenever the &Reference[charmed apply=false] target takes damage, it repeats the [[/save ability=wis]] save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

Legendary Resistance.name: Legendary Resistance
Legendary Resistance.description: If Whitemane fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Loksey makes two [[/item Handaxe]] attacks.

Handaxe.name: Handaxe
Handaxe.description: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]] plus an extra [[/damage average activity=CCTOnBRt9KH5gAVJ]] damage if the target is within 5 feet of a Beast.

Kill Command.name: Kill Command
Kill Command.description: Each of up to three Beasts of Loksey’s choice within 60 feet of him can take a Reaction to move up to half its Speed and make one attack.

Aura of Loyalty.name: Aura of Loyalty
Aura of Loyalty.description:
Loksey emanates an aura in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=PgdATzePGt76NKo8]]-foot Emanation while he doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.

Each Beast in the aura has Advantage on saving throws, gains [[/heal average]] when it starts its turn in the aura, and deals an extra [[/damage average]] damage when it hits with an attack roll.

Foundry Note

Apply the Adv. on Saves active effect to each qualifying Beast. Remove the effect when the Beast leaves the aura or Loksey becomes Incapacitated.

Legendary Resistance.name: Legendary Resistance
Legendary Resistance.description: If Loksey fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Illidan makes one [[/item Flame Crash]] attack and two [[/item Warglaive]] attacks. He can replace one Flame Crash attack with a use of [[/item Shadow Blast]] in his Demon Form.

Shadow Blast.name: Shadow Blast
Shadow Blast.description:
Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=kkN82ES5McrR4pS1]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=kkN82ES5McrR4pS1]]-foot-radius [[lookup @target.template.type capitalize activity=kkN82ES5McrR4pS1]] centered on a point Illidan can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=kkN82ES5McrR4pS1]] feet.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage.

Success: Half damage.

Agonizing Flames.name: Agonizing Flames
Agonizing Flames.description:
Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=uBqwK2eoXQrpKtfg]], one creature Illidan can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=uBqwK2eoXQrpKtfg]] feet.

Failure: [[/damage average activity=uBqwK2eoXQrpKtfg]] damage, and the target starts burning, taking [[/damage activity=BUqnpMjfWgKBucTL]] damage at the start of each of its turns instead of the normal burning damage.

Success: Half damage only.

Failure or Success: Illidan can’t take this action again until the start of his next turn.

Draw Soul.name: Draw Soul
Draw Soul.description:
Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=3uecNHVQ2lqgUn4f]], one creature Illidan can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=3uecNHVQ2lqgUn4f]] feet.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage. The target dies if this damage reduces it to 0 Hit Points.

Failure or Success: Illidan can’t take this action again until the start of his next turn.

Strike.name: Strike
Strike.description: Illidan moves up to half his Speed and makes one [[/item Flame Crash]] or [[/item Warglaive]] attack.

Demon Form.name: Demon Form
Demon Form.description: Illidan regains 100 Hit Points and takes the form of the Demon Within for 1 minute or until Illidan dies. While in this form, Illidan can use his Aura of Dread trait, his Shadow Blast action, and his Draw Soul legendary action.

Agile Movement.name: Agile Movement
Agile Movement.description: &Reference[Opportunity Attacks] made against Illidan have Disadvantage.

Aura of Dread.name: Aura of Dread
Aura of Dread.description:
Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=U2cPKknlK1Vdp1yM]], any creature that starts its turn in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=U2cPKknlK1Vdp1yM]]-foot Emanation originating from Illidan.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target can’t regain Hit Points until the end of its next turn.

Can't Regain HP.name: Can't Regain HP
Can't Regain HP.description: The target can’t regain Hit Points until the end of its next turn.

Legendary Resistance.name: Legendary Resistance
Legendary Resistance.description: If Illidan fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

Magic Resistance.name: Magic Resistance
Magic Resistance.description: Illidan has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Illyanna makes three attacks using [[/item Scimitar]] and [[/item Longbow]] in any combination.

Explosive Trap.name: Explosive Trap
Explosive Trap.description:
Illyanna places an Invisible, intangible trap on the ground at a point she can see within 60 feet, which lasts until the end of her next turn. Illyanna can’t take this action again until the start of her next turn.

The first time a creature other than Illyanna comes within 5 feet of the trap, it explodes, and each creature within a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on the trap is subjected to the following effect.

Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=sZqtpKEflXRsVqme]].

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage.

Success: Half damage.

Foundry Note

After placing the 5-foot trigger Region, set its visibility to Gamemaster. When a creature other than Illyanna first enters it, use Explode centered on the trap, then delete both Regions. If the trap is not triggered, delete its Region at the end of Illyanna’s next turn.

Kill Command.name: Kill Command
Kill Command.description: An allied Undead within 60 feet of Illyanna can move up to half its Speed and make one attack.

Magic Resistance.name: Magic Resistance
Magic Resistance.description: Illyanna has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Legendary Resistance.name: Legendary Resistance
Legendary Resistance.description: If Illyanna fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Immol’thar makes two [[/item Bite]] attacks and uses [[/item Stomp]].

Stomp.name: Stomp
Stomp.description:
Strength Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=XGOjjwCJ9W7Haofw]], one creature Immol’thar can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=XGOjjwCJ9W7Haofw]] feet.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition.

Success: Half damage only.

Fel Rush.name: Fel Rush
Fel Rush.description:
Immol’thar moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Each creature within 5 feet of Immol’thar as it moves is targeted once by the following effect.

Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=93BdlA41hEsmJGYZ]].

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage.

Success: Half damage.

Failure or Success: Immol’thar can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

Foundry Note

Move Immol’thar manually, then target each creature that came within 5 feet during the move once before rolling Fel Rush. The Activity does not detect the movement path or suppress Opportunity Attacks.

save.range: within 5 feet of Immol’thar during its movement

Withering Gaze.name: Withering Gaze
Withering Gaze.description:
Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18, one creature Immol’thar can see within 60 feet.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Poisoned apply=false] condition until the end of its next turn.

Summon Eyes of Immol’thar.name: Summon Eyes of Immol’thar
Summon Eyes of Immol’thar.description:
Two Eyes of Immol’thar appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of Immol’thar.

Each Eye is a Tiny object that has AC 19, HP 10, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. A creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of an Eye has its Speed halved, takes a −2 penalty to AC and Dexterity saving throws, and can’t take Reactions.

On its turn, it can take either an action or a Bonus Action, not both, and it can make only one attack if it takes the Attack action.

Immol’thar can move both Eyes up to 60 feet as a Bonus Action on its turn.

Foundry Note

No Eye Actor is currently available. Place and move two marker tokens manually, and track each Eye’s AC, Hit Points, immunities, and destruction outside Actor automation. At the start of an affected creature’s turn, use Apply Eye Suppression. Remove the effect manually. Foundry does not enforce the reaction, action, Bonus Action, or attack restrictions.

Summon Eyes.name: Summon Eyes
Summon Eyes.description: Two Eyes of Immol’thar appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of Immol’thar.

Move Eyes.name: Move Eyes
Move Eyes.description: Immol’thar moves both Eyes up to 60 feet.
Move Eyes.range: each Eye moves up to 60 feet

Apply Eye Suppression.name: Apply Eye Suppression
Apply Eye Suppression.condition: A creature starts its turn within 5 feet of an Eye.
Apply Eye Suppression.description: Apply Eye Suppression to one creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of an Eye. The target’s Speed is halved, it takes a −2 penalty to AC and Dexterity saving throws, and it can’t take Reactions. On its turn, it can take either an action or a Bonus Action, not both, and it can make only one attack if it takes the Attack action.

Legendary Resistance.name: Legendary Resistance
Legendary Resistance.description: If Immol’thar fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The infernal makes two [[/item Slam]] attacks.

Lob Felfire.name: Lob Felfire
Lob Felfire.description:
The infernal hurls a ball of exploding felfire.

Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=OWSvJgHMUfBnw7CI]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=OWSvJgHMUfBnw7CI]]-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the infernal can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=OWSvJgHMUfBnw7CI]] feet.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage.

Success: Half damage.

Berserk.name: Berserk
Berserk.description:
Whenever the infernal starts its turn Bloodied, roll [[/r 1d6]]. On a 6, the infernal goes berserk.

On each of its turns while berserk, the infernal uses its [[/item Multiattack]] or [[/item Lob Felfire]] (if available), targeting the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the infernal attacks an object.

Once the infernal goes berserk, it continues to be berserk until it is destroyed or it is no longer Bloodied.

Death Burst.name: Death Burst
Death Burst.description:
The infernal explodes when it dies.

Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=B8Rpu75b9t14JI0S]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=B8Rpu75b9t14JI0S]]-foot Emanation originating from the infernal.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage.

Success: Half damage.

Magic Resistance.name: Magic Resistance
Magic Resistance.description: The infernal has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Siege Monster.name: Siege Monster
Siege Monster.description: The infernal deals double damage to objects and structures.

Ivar Bloodfang.name: Ivar Bloodfang
Ivar Bloodfang.description:
Gear: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepGreatsword]{Greatsword}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbwepHeavyCross]{Heavy Crossbow}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbarmSplintArmo]{Splint Armor}

Warriors

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.content.JournalEntry.mmAppendixMonste.JournalEntryPage.3Il3CvacAVpf6Rch caption=false cite=false classes="no-embed mm"]

Warrior Veteran

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-monster-manual.content.JournalEntry.mmAppendixMonste.JournalEntryPage.Dqm3ro7bU8A7sM4B caption=false cite=false classes="no-embed mm"]

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] makes two [[/item .KkRkIIhD17sL5x30]] or [[/item .0nNkeR6HNC1e2uQ3]] attacks.

Parry.name: Parry
Parry.description: Trigger: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] is [[lookup @activation.condition activity=aLG3BRZL7P6OEjwd]]. Response: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] adds [[lookup @prof]] to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

Use.name: Use
Use.condition: hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon

Spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
Spellcasting.description:
Jaina casts one of the following spells, using [[lookup @attributes.spell.abilityLabel]] as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]):

At Will: [[/item .FoK424VXI3qSTxPL]]{Elementalism}, [[/item .A9GNDnEwxwIhBbQy]]{Mage Armor} (included in AC), [[/item .Q8frk2wfY20ZnNkW]]{Mage Hand}, [[/item .ahqdgbeyNOZh6OOa]]{Message}

2/Day Each: [[/item .0OErBGV2MIwovWYp]]{Detect Thoughts}, [[/item .dpHsp8IeVZfgSdGt]]{Invisibility}

1/Day Each: [[/item .veBkrErkCVu19opR]]{Mind Blank} (cast before combat), [[/item .DudP418dyDdfTJgW]]{Teleport}, [[/item .iS4YX41JJVRd6oKM]]{Wall of Force}

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Jaina makes three attacks, using [[/item Staff of Antonidas]] or [[/item Ice Shard]] in any combination. She can replace one attack with a use of Ice Prison or Shattering Lance if available.

Ice Prison.name: Ice Prison
Ice Prison.description:
Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=6TcLB5a5wePvVH4M]], one creature Jaina can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=6TcLB5a5wePvVH4M]] feet.

Failure: The target has the &Reference[Petrified apply=false] condition until the end of Jaina’s next turn, turning into a frozen statue. While Petrified, if the target would take Fire damage, it instead takes no damage and thaws, ending the effect.

Petrified.name: Petrified
Petrified.description: The target has the &Reference[Petrified apply=false] condition until the end of Jaina’s next turn, turning into a frozen statue.

Shattering Lance.name: Shattering Lance
Shattering Lance.description:
Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=vPdlM4Ew6lFqqTRM]], one creature Jaina can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=vPdlM4Ew6lFqqTRM]] feet.

Failure: [[/damage average activity=vPdlM4Ew6lFqqTRM]] damage. If the target is under the effect of [[/item Ice Prison]], the effect ends and each creature other than the target in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=qjYMyG4DHlhwLqcE]]-foot Emanation originating from the target takes [[/damage average activity=qjYMyG4DHlhwLqcE]] damage.

Shatter Ice Prison.name: Shatter Ice Prison
Shatter Ice Prison.condition: Only when Ice Prison is present

Frost Nova.name: Frost Nova
Frost Nova.description:
Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=ClECB7P6dsZQBFNu]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=ClECB7P6dsZQBFNu]]-foot Emanation originating from Jaina.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target’s Speed is 0 until the end of its next turn.

Success: Half damage only.

Failure or Success: Jaina can’t take this action again until the start of her next turn.

Speed 0 Feet.name: Speed 0 Feet
Speed 0 Feet.description: The target’s Speed is 0 until the end of its next turn.

Ice Barrier.name: Ice Barrier
Ice Barrier.description: Jaina gains [[/healing]]. Jaina can’t take this action again until the start of her next turn.

Misty Step.name: Misty Step
Misty Step.description: Jaina casts [[/item .Tdb1YoErEoxahT7Y]]{Misty Step}, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

Freezing Counterspell.name: Freezing Counterspell
Freezing Counterspell.description: Jaina casts [[/item .5D7qSt3lAa1n8Jpc]]{Counterspell} in response to that spell’s trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. If the target fails its saving throw, it has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition until the end of its next turn.

Restrained.name: Restrained
Restrained.description: The target has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition until the end of its next turn.

Master of Frost.name: Master of Frost
Master of Frost.description: Damage from Jaina’s [[/item Staff of Antonidas]], [[/item Ice Shard]], [[/item Shattering Lance]], and [[/item Frost Nova]] ignores Resistance to Cold damage.

Tdb1YoErEoxahT7Y.name: Misty Step
Tdb1YoErEoxahT7Y.description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

Counterspell.name: Counterspell
Counterspell.description: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell. The creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the spell dissipates with no effect, and the action, Bonus Action, or Reaction used to cast it is wasted. If that spell was cast with a spell slot, the slot isn’t expended.

Elementalism.name: Elementalism
Elementalism.description:
You exert control over the elements, creating one of the following effects within range.

Beckon Air. You create a breeze strong enough to ripple cloth, stir dust, rustle leaves, and close open doors and shutters, all in a 5-foot Cube. Doors and shutters being held open by someone or something aren’t affected.

Beckon Earth. You create a thin shroud of dust or sand that covers surfaces in a 5-foot-square area, or you cause a single word to appear in your handwriting in a patch of dirt or sand.

Beckon Fire. You create a thin cloud of harmless embers and colored, scented smoke in a 5-foot Cube. You choose the color and scent, and the embers can light candles, torches, or lamps in that area. The smoke’s scent lingers for 1 minute.

Beckon Water. You create a spray of cool mist that lightly dampens creatures and objects in a 5-foot Cube. Alternatively, you create 1 cup of clean water either in an open container or on a surface, and the water evaporates in 1 minute.

Sculpt Element. You cause dirt, sand, fire, smoke, mist, or water that can fit in a 1-foot Cube to assume a crude shape (such as that of a creature) for 1 hour.

Beckon Element.name: Beckon Element
Beckon Element.chatFlavor: Fire and water beckoning lasts for 1 minute

Mage Armor.name: Mage Armor
Mage Armor.description: You touch a willing creature who isn’t wearing armor. Until the spell ends, the target’s base AC becomes 13 plus its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends early if the target dons armor.

Mage Armor.name: Mage Armor
Mage Armor.description: The target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier.

Mage Hand.name: Mage Hand
Mage Hand.description:
A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.

When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.

As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.

The hand can’t attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

Message.name: Message
Message.description:
You point toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target (and only the target) hears the message and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear.

You can cast this spell through solid objects if you are familiar with the target and know it is beyond the barrier. Magical silence; 1 foot of stone, metal, or wood; or a thin sheet of lead blocks the spell.

Detect Thoughts.name: Detect Thoughts
Detect Thoughts.description:
You activate one of the effects below. Until the spell ends, you can activate either effect as a Magic action on your later turns.

Sense Thoughts. You sense the presence of thoughts within 30 feet of yourself that belong to creatures that know languages or are telepathic. You don’t read the thoughts, but you know that a thinking creature is present.

The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

Read Thoughts. Target one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself or one creature within 30 feet of yourself that you detected with the Sense Thoughts option. You learn what is most on the target’s mind right now. If the target doesn’t know any languages and isn’t telepathic, you learn nothing.

As a Magic action on your next turn, you can try to probe deeper into the target’s mind. If you probe deeper, the target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you discern the target’s reasoning, emotions, and something that looms large in its mind (such as a worry, love, or hate). On a successful save, the spell ends. Either way, the target knows that you are probing into its mind, and until you shift your attention away from the target’s mind, the target can take an action on its turn to make an [[/check ability=int skill=arc dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] check against your spell save DC, ending the spell on a success.

Invisibility.name: Invisibility
Invisibility.description:
A creature you touch has the &Reference[invisible apply=false] condition until the spell ends. The spell ends early immediately after the target makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

Invisible.name: Invisible
Invisible.description: The spell ends early immediately after the target makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.

Mind Blank.name: Mind Blank
Mind Blank.description: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch has Immunity to Psychic damage and the Charmed condition. The target is also unaffected by anything that would sense its emotions or alignment, read its thoughts, or magically detect its location, and no spell—not even @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplWish000000]{Wish}—can gather information about the target, observe it remotely, or control its mind.

Wall of Force.name: Wall of Force
Wall of Force.description:
An Invisible wall of force springs into existence at a point you choose within range. The wall appears in any orientation you choose, as a horizontal or vertical barrier or at an angle. It can be free floating or resting on a solid surface. You can form it into a hemispherical dome or a globe with a radius of up to 10 feet, or you can shape a flat surface made up of ten 10-foot-by-10-foot panels. Each panel must be contiguous with another panel. In any form, the wall is 1/4 inch thick and lasts for the duration. If the wall cuts through a creature’s space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (you choose which side).

Nothing can physically pass through the wall. It is immune to all damage and can’t be dispelled by @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplDispelMagi]{Dispel Magic}. A @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplDisintegra]{Disintegrate} spell destroys the wall instantly, however. The wall also extends into the Ethereal Plane and blocks ethereal travel through the wall.

Teleport.name: Teleport
Teleport.description:
This spell instantly transports you and up to eight willing creatures that you can see within range, or a single object that you can see within range, to a destination you select. If you target an object, it must be Large or smaller, and it can’t be held or carried by an unwilling creature.

The destination you choose must be known to you, and it must be on the same plane of existence as you. Your familiarity with the destination determines whether you arrive there successfully. The DM rolls [[/gmr 1d100]] and consults the Teleportation Outcome table and the explanations after it.

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.tables.RollTable.phbsplTeleportMi]{Teleportation Outcome}
FamiliarityMishapSimilar AreaOff TargetOn Target
Permanent circle———01–00
Linked object———01–00
Very familiar01–0506–1314–2425–00
Seen casually01–3334–4344–5354–00
Viewed once or described01–4344–5354–7374–00
False destination01–5051–00——

Familiarity. Here are the meanings of the terms in the table’s Familiarity column:

  • “Permanent circle” means a permanent teleportation circle whose sigil sequence you know.
  • “Linked object” means you possess an object taken from the desired destination within the last six months, such as a book from a wizard’s library.
  • “Very familiar” is a place you have visited often, a place you have carefully studied, or a place you can see when you cast the spell.
  • “Seen casually” is a place you have seen more than once but with which you aren’t very familiar.
  • “Viewed once or described” is a place you have seen once, possibly using magic, or a place you know through someone else’s description, perhaps from a map.
  • “False destination” is a place that doesn’t exist. Perhaps you tried to scry an enemy’s sanctum but instead viewed an illusion, or you are attempting to teleport to a location that no longer exists.

Mishap. The spell’s unpredictable magic results in a difficult journey. Each teleporting creature (or the target object) takes [[/damage 3d10 type=force]] damage, and the DM rerolls on the table to see where you wind up (multiple mishaps can occur, dealing damage each time).

Similar Area. You and your group (or the target object) appear in a different area that’s visually or thematically similar to the target area. You appear in the closest similar place. If you are heading for your home laboratory, for example, you might appear in another person’s laboratory in the same city.

Off Target. You and your group (or the target object) appear [[/r 2d12]] miles away from the destination in a random direction. Roll [[/r 1d8]] for the direction: 1, east; 2, southeast; 3, south; 4, southwest; 5, west; 6, northwest; 7, north; or 8, northeast.

On Target. You and your group (or the target object) appear where you intended.
Teleport.target: you and up to eight creatures or one object

Legendary Resistance.name: Legendary Resistance
Legendary Resistance.description: If Jaina fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

Magic Resistance.name: Magic Resistance
Magic Resistance.description: Jaina has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Component Pouch.name: Component Pouch
Component Pouch.description: A Component Pouch is watertight and filled with compartments that hold all the free Material components of your spells.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Gordok makes two attacks using [[/item Barbarous Blade]] or [[/item Boulder]] in any combination.

Barbarous Blade.name: Barbarous Blade
Barbarous Blade.description:
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a creature and doesn’t already have a rending wound, it is subjected to the following effect.

Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=WiLvMkPqd1NmlSlM]].

Failure: The target receives a rending wound. While wounded, the target loses [[/damage average activity=avQK0G6BkVwyxvpd]] Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. The wound closes after 1 minute, after a spell restores Hit Points to the target, or after the target or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to stanch the wound, doing so by succeeding on a [[/check format=long]].

Foundry Note

Use Rending Wound only after a qualifying hit and failed save, and only if the target lacks the effect. At the start of the wounded creature's turn, roll Rending Wound HP Loss and subtract the result directly from HP. Remove the effect when a closing condition is met.

Save: Rending Wound.name: Save: Rending Wound
Save: Rending Wound.condition: after Barbarous Blade hits a creature that does not already have the Rending Wound effect.

Boulder.name: Boulder
Boulder.description: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition.

Berserk Charge.name: Berserk Charge
Berserk Charge.description: Gordok moves up to his Speed and makes one [[/item Barbarous Blade]] attack.

War Stomp.name: War Stomp
War Stomp.description:
Strength Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=5A5SBWrQhIXGVULp]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=5A5SBWrQhIXGVULp]]-foot Emanation.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition until the end of its next turn.

Success: Half damage only.

Failure or Success: Gordok can’t take this action again until the start of his next turn.

Legendary Resistance.name: Legendary Resistance
Legendary Resistance.description: If Gordok fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

Spider Climb.name: Spider Climb
Spider Climb.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Krik’thir makes a [[/item Bite]] attack and two [[/item Claw]] attacks. He can replace one Claw attack with a use of [[/item Mind Web]].

Mind Web.name: Mind Web
Mind Web.description:
Intelligence Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=mVGtcNFb9059SvPG]], one creature within [[lookup @range.value activity=mVGtcNFb9059SvPG]] feet.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Stunned apply=false] condition. Krik’thir maintains &Reference[Concentration] on this ability; the Stunned condition ends when his Concentration is broken.

Success: Half damage only.

Sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
Sacrifice.description: Krik’thir chooses an Undead ally within 60 feet. It dies. If the Undead was CR 10 or higher, Krik’thir regains 115 ([[/r 11d12 + 44]]) Hit Points and gains Resistance to all damage until the start of his next turn.

Consume Sacrifice.name: Consume Sacrifice
Consume Sacrifice.condition: Sacrificed Undead ally was CR 10 or higher

Craven Retreat.name: Craven Retreat
Craven Retreat.description: Krik’thir moves up to his Speed, then uses [[/item Sacrifice]]. He can’t take this action again until the start of his next turn.

Curse of Fatigue.name: Curse of Fatigue
Curse of Fatigue.description:
Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=BZ4vEy7cIagG5SmY]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=BZ4vEy7cIagG5SmY]]-foot Emanation originating from Krik’thir.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target is cursed until Krik’thir dies. While cursed, it can take either an Action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both, and it can’t take Reactions.

Foundry Note

Remove the Curse of Fatigue active effect from affected creatures if Krik’thir dies.

Curse of Fatigue.name: Curse of Fatigue
Curse of Fatigue.description: While cursed, it can take either an Action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both, and it can’t take Reactions.

Lunge.name: Lunge
Lunge.description: Krik’thir moves up to half his Speed, and he makes a [[/item Claw]] attack. He can then move up to half his Speed again.

Pack Tactics.name: Pack Tactics
Pack Tactics.description: Krik’thir has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of his allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.

Spider Climb.name: Spider Climb
Spider Climb.description: Krik’thir can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

Undead Fortitude.name: Undead Fortitude
Undead Fortitude.description: If damage reduces Krik’thir to 0 Hit Points, he makes a Constitution saving throw (DC 5 plus the damage taken) unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a successful save, Krik’thir drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

Web Walker.name: Web Walker
Web Walker.description: Krik’thir ignores movement restrictions caused by webs and knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

Legendary Resistance.name: Legendary Resistance
Legendary Resistance.description: If Krik’thir fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

Spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
Spellcasting.description:
Sarevess casts one of the following spells, using [[lookup @attributes.spell.abilityLabel]] as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]):

At Will: [[/item .cCBbORuaJBW3IbcY]]{Detect Thoughts}, [[/item .SwEjsGJjduR6okSi]]{Mage Hand}

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Sarevess makes three [[/item Lightning Blast]] attacks.

Frost Nova.name: Frost Nova
Frost Nova.description:
Trigger: An enemy Sarevess can see enters a space within [[lookup @range.value activity=ZKXdLoxzy4Vyw3Pt]] feet of her.

Response—Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=ZKXdLoxzy4Vyw3Pt]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=ZKXdLoxzy4Vyw3Pt]]-foot Emanation originating from Sarevess.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition until the end of its next turn.

save.condition: An enemy Sarevess can see enters a space within 20 feet of her.

Freedom of Movement.name: Freedom of Movement
Freedom of Movement.description:
Sarevess’s movement is unaffected by &Reference[Difficult Terrain], and spells and other magical effects can’t reduce her Speed.

Foundry Note

If a spell or other magical effect reduces Sarevess’s Speed, restore the affected Speed. Leave nonmagical reductions in place.

Magic Resistance.name: Magic Resistance
Magic Resistance.description: Sarevess has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Detect Thoughts.name: Detect Thoughts
Detect Thoughts.description:
You activate one of the effects below. Until the spell ends, you can activate either effect as a Magic action on your later turns.

Sense Thoughts. You sense the presence of thoughts within 30 feet of yourself that belong to creatures that know languages or are telepathic. You don’t read the thoughts, but you know that a thinking creature is present.

The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

Read Thoughts. Target one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself or one creature within 30 feet of yourself that you detected with the Sense Thoughts option. You learn what is most on the target’s mind right now. If the target doesn’t know any languages and isn’t telepathic, you learn nothing.

As a Magic action on your next turn, you can try to probe deeper into the target’s mind. If you probe deeper, the target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you discern the target’s reasoning, emotions, and something that looms large in its mind (such as a worry, love, or hate). On a successful save, the spell ends. Either way, the target knows that you are probing into its mind, and until you shift your attention away from the target’s mind, the target can take an action on its turn to make an [[/check ability=int skill=arc dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] check against your spell save DC, ending the spell on a success.

Mage Hand.name: Mage Hand
Mage Hand.description:
A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.

When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.

As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.

The hand can’t attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

Legendary Resistance.name: Legendary Resistance
Legendary Resistance.description: If Sarevess fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

Spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
Spellcasting.description:
Arthas casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using [[lookup @attributes.spell.abilityLabel]] as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]):

At Will: [[/item .Ti0N6XrVD0YKD8JC]]{Animate Dead}, [[/item .1Ey9Peyk9n2tz1Lt]]{Create Undead}, [[/item .a3VQanJTsHMsB7pA]]{Finger of Death}

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Arthas makes two attacks, using [[/item Frostmourne]] or [[/item Ice Burst]] in any combination. He can replace one attack with a use of [[/item Spellcasting]] to cast [[/item .a3VQanJTsHMsB7pA]]{Finger of Death}.

Soul Reaper.name: Soul Reaper
Soul Reaper.description:
Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=SV1YtTNcHjY6OjXl]], the hit target.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage. The target dies if it is reduced to 0 Hit Points, and its soul is trapped in Frostmourne. The target can’t be raised from the dead until its soul is released.

Suffering Wave.name: Suffering Wave
Suffering Wave.description:
Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=pSuBBM4PkNARPoG6]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=pSuBBM4PkNARPoG6]]-foot [[lookup @target.template.type capitalize activity=pSuBBM4PkNARPoG6]].

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage.

Ice Burst.name: Ice Burst
Ice Burst.description: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]], and the target is pushed up to 10 feet straight away from Arthas.

Helm Spellcasting.name: Helm Spellcasting
Helm Spellcasting.description:
Arthas casts one of the following spells (spell save DC 18), some of which require charges; the helm has 8 charges to fuel these spells, and it regains [[/r 1d4 + 4]] charges daily at dawn:

At Will: [[/item .T1CQBIIvpicOt0LD]]{Speak with Dead}

1 Charge Each: [[/item .ANVIbCxAPGKkRxZi]]{Clairvoyance}, [[/item .XFe4WPaeK05Qnn7r]]{Dream}

4 Charges Each: [[/item .ANVRIdtotBctaKus]]{Telepathy}, [[/item .u7ppVx16pBzXzQvx]]{Word of Recall}

Remorseless Winter.name: Remorseless Winter
Remorseless Winter.description:
Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=RvD2HUyiBMuBZfM1]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=RvD2HUyiBMuBZfM1]]-foot Emanation originating from Arthas.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the creature gains 1 &Reference[Exhaustion apply=false] level.

Success: Half damage only.

Failure or Success: Arthas can’t take this action again until the start of his next turn.

Strike.name: Strike
Strike.description: Arthas moves up to his Speed and makes one [[/item Frostmourne]] or [[/item Ice Burst]] attack.

Rush.name: Rush
Rush.description: Arthas moves up to his Speed without provoking &Reference[Opportunity Attacks].

Defile.name: Defile
Defile.description: Arthas casts [[/item .bhw66Ux67Jlgv6tA]]{Counterspell}, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. If the target fails its saving throw, it is cursed until the end of its next turn. When the curse ends, the target and each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=EqONPihMH9zboMam]]-foot Emanation originating from the target take [[/damage average activity=EqONPihMH9zboMam]] damage.

Special Equipment.name: Special Equipment
Special Equipment.description: Arthas wields the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.items.Item.wowHelmofDominAS]{Helm of Domination} (included in Languages) and @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.items.Item.wowFrostmourneKA]{Frostmourne}. While wielding them, Arthas can use the Frostmourne and Helm Spellcasting actions.

Counterspell.name: Counterspell
Counterspell.description: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell. The creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the spell dissipates with no effect, and the action, Bonus Action, or Reaction used to cast it is wasted. If that spell was cast with a spell slot, the slot isn’t expended.

Animate Dead.name: Animate Dead
Animate Dead.description:
Choose a pile of bones or a corpse of a Medium or Small Humanoid within range. The target becomes an Undead creature: a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbmobSkeleton00]{Skeleton} if you chose bones or a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbmobZombie0000]{Zombie} if you chose a corpse.

On each of your turns, you can take a Bonus Action to mentally command any creature you made with this spell if the creature is within 60 feet of you (if you control multiple creatures, you can command any of them at the same time, issuing the same command to each one). You decide what action the creature will take and where it will move on its next turn, or you can issue a general command, such as to guard a chamber or corridor. If you issue no commands, the creature takes the Dodge action and moves only to avoid harm. Once given an order, the creature continues to follow it until its task is complete.

The creature is under your control for 24 hours, after which it stops obeying any command you’ve given it. To maintain control of the creature for another 24 hours, you must cast this spell on the creature again before the current 24-hour period ends. This use of the spell reasserts your control over up to four creatures you have animated with this spell rather than animating a new creature.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You animate or reassert control over two additional Undead creatures for each spell slot level above 3. Each of the creatures must come from a different corpse or pile of bones.

Finger of Death.name: Finger of Death
Finger of Death.description:
You unleash negative energy toward a creature you can see within range. The target makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 7d8 + 30 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

A Humanoid killed by this spell rises at the start of your next turn as a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbmobZombie0000]{Zombie} (see appendix B) that follows your verbal orders.

Create Undead.name: Create Undead
Create Undead.description:
You can cast this spell only at night. Choose up to three corpses of Medium or Small Humanoids within range. Each one becomes a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.OBujQLLPSmlJiZnL]{Ghoul} under your control (see the Monster Manual for its stat block).

As a Bonus Action on each of your turns, you can mentally command any creature you animated with this spell if the creature is within 120 feet of you (if you control multiple creatures, you can command any of them at the same time, issuing the same command to them). You decide what action the creature will take and where it will move on its next turn, or you can issue a general command, such as to guard a particular place. If you issue no commands, the creature takes the &Reference[Dodge] action and moves only to avoid harm. Once given an order, the creature continues to follow the order until its task is complete.

The creature is under your control for 24 hours, after which it stops obeying any command you’ve given it. To maintain control of the creature for another 24 hours, you must cast this spell on the creature before the current 24-hour period ends. This use of the spell reasserts your control over up to three creatures you have animated with this spell rather than animating new ones.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.If you use a level 7 spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over four Ghouls. If you use a level 8 spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over five Ghouls or two @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.IyIybE5t2adMEVUM]{Ghasts} or @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.rbyp54px2D0ql4QK]{Wights}. If you use a level 9 spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over six Ghouls, three Ghasts or Wights, or two @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.t8WYD7ak07X7xpx8]{Mummies}. See the Monster Manual for these stat blocks.
Create Undead.target: corpse of Medium or Small Humanoid or previously created undead

Speak with Dead.name: Speak with Dead
Speak with Dead.description:
You grant the semblance of life to a corpse of your choice within range, allowing it to answer questions you pose. The corpse must have a mouth, and this spell fails if the deceased creature was Undead when it died. The spell also fails if the corpse was the target of this spell within the past 10 days.

Until the spell ends, you can ask the corpse up to five questions. The corpse knows only what it knew in life, including the languages it knew. Answers are usually brief, cryptic, or repetitive, and the corpse is under no compulsion to offer a truthful answer if you are antagonistic toward it or it recognizes you as an enemy. This spell doesn’t return the creature’s soul to its body, only its animating spirit. Thus, the corpse can’t learn new information, doesn’t comprehend anything that has happened since it died, and can’t speculate about future events.

Dream.name: Dream
Dream.description:
You target a creature you know on the same plane of existence. You or a willing creature you touch enters a trance state to act as a dream messenger. While in the trance, the messenger is &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] and has a Speed of 0.

If the target is asleep, the messenger appears in the target’s dreams and can converse with the target as long as it remains asleep, through the spell’s duration. The messenger can also shape the dream’s environment, creating landscapes, objects, and other images. The messenger can emerge from the trance at any time, ending the spell. The target recalls the dream perfectly upon waking.

If the target is awake when you cast the spell, the messenger knows it and can either end the trance (and the spell) or wait for the target to sleep, at which point the messenger enters its dreams.

You can make the messenger terrifying to the target. If you do so, the messenger can deliver a message of no more than ten words, and then the target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target gains no benefit from its rest, and it takes 3d6 Psychic damage when it wakes up.

Trance State.name: Trance State
Trance State.description: While in the trance, the messenger is Incapacitated and has a Speed of 0.

Word of Recall.name: Word of Recall
Word of Recall.description:
You and up to five willing creatures within 5 feet of you instantly teleport to a previously designated sanctuary. You and any creatures that teleport with you appear in the nearest unoccupied space to the spot you designated when you prepared your sanctuary (see below). If you cast this spell without first preparing a sanctuary, the spell has no effect.

You must designate a location, such as a temple, as a sanctuary by casting this spell there.

Clairvoyance.name: Clairvoyance
Clairvoyance.description:
You create an Invisible sensor within range in a location familiar to you (a place you have visited or seen before) or in an obvious location that is unfamiliar to you (such as behind a door, around a corner, or in a grove of trees). The intangible, invulnerable sensor remains in place for the duration.

When you cast the spell, choose seeing or hearing. You can use the chosen sense through the sensor as if you were in its space. As a Bonus Action, you can switch between seeing and hearing.

A creature that sees the sensor (such as a creature benefiting from See Invisibility or &Reference[truesight]) sees a luminous orb about the size of your fist.

Telepathy.name: Telepathy
Telepathy.description:
You create a telepathic link between yourself and a willing creature with which you are familiar. The creature can be anywhere on the same plane of existence as you. The spell ends if you or the target are no longer on the same plane.

Until the spell ends, you and the target can instantly share words, images, sounds, and other sensory messages with each other through the link, and the target recognizes you as the creature it is communicating with. The spell enables a creature to understand the meaning of your words and any sensory messages you send to it.

Legendary Resistance.name: Legendary Resistance
Legendary Resistance.description: If Arthas fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

Magic Resistance.name: Magic Resistance
Magic Resistance.description: Arthas has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Marshal Undead.name: Marshal Undead
Marshal Undead.description: Undead creatures of Arthas’s choice (excluding him) within 1 mile of him have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws if Arthas doesn’t have the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition.

Adv: Attacks & Saves.name: Adv: Attacks & Saves
Adv: Attacks & Saves.description: The creature has Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws. It can’t use this trait if it has the Incapacitated condition.

Helm of Domination.name: Helm of Domination
Helm of Domination.description:
This ornate helm is infused with the power of domination—a form of runic magic intended to utterly suppress the will of another being. The helm (along with its companion Artifact, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.items.Item.wowFrostmourneKA]{Frostmourne}) allowed its wearers—three successive Lich Kings—to rule the Scourge.

Attuning to the Helm. When you attune to the helm, make a DC 18 Charisma saving throw. On a successful save, you take 10d6 Psychic damage. On a failed save, your soul merges with the Lich King, who then takes control of your body like a puppet, and you become an NPC under the DM’s control.

While attuned to the helm, you are unwilling to part with the helm, wearing it at all times, and you can’t voluntarily end your Attunement to the helm.

Properties of the Helm. While attuned to the helm, your alignment is Neutral Evil, and you gain the following benefits:

Command the Scourge. As a Magic action, you can send a psychic command to each Undead that is part of the Scourge. Make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (DC 20). On a successful check, you can issue a general command to the Undead Scourge, such as “attack any creature you come across” or “guard my stronghold,” or you can issue a command to a specific member of the Scourge, such as “deliver a plague to Stormwind.” Whether or not you succeed, this property of the helm can’t be used again until the next dawn.

Truesight. You have Truesight with a range of 120 feet.

Spellcasting. The helm has 8 charges and regains 1d4 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the helm, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it (save DC 18). The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell.

Spell

Charge Cost

Animate Dead

1

Clairvoyance

2

Dream

4

Speak with Dead

1

Telepathy

5

Word of Recall

5

Random Properties. The Helm of Domination
has the following random properties:

  • @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.tables.RollTable.dmgMajorBenefici]{1 major beneficial property}

  • @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.tables.RollTable.dmgMinorDetrimen]{1 minor detrimental property}

  • @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.tables.RollTable.dmgMajorDetrimen]{1 major detrimental property}

Destroying the Helm of Domination. The helm is shattered if struck by a blade forged in the Shadowlands. Only the Runecarver, who originally forged the helm, can reforge it from the fragments.

Attuning to the Helm.name: Attuning to the Helm
Attuning to the Helm.description: When you attune to the helm, make a DC 18 Charisma saving throw. On a successful save, roll and apply this Activity’s 10d6 Psychic damage. On a failed save, your soul merges with the Lich King, who takes control of your body like a puppet, and you become an NPC under the DM’s control.

Frostmourne.name: Frostmourne
Frostmourne.description:
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]].

Runes of domination adorn this icy mourneblade. The Jailer—one of the rulers of the Shadowlands—originally sought to use Frostmourne to subjugate Azeroth, and that cruel intention forever lingers in the form of a prophecy: “Whosoever takes up this blade shall wield power eternal. Just as the blade rends flesh, so must power scar the spirit.” Arthas Menethil was the first to discover the prophecy’s true meaning when he lost his soul by wielding the sword, ultimately becoming the Lich King.

Magic Weapon. You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It deals an extra 2d12 Cold damage on a hit. Whenever you use Frostmourne to reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points, the creature dies, and its soul is trapped in the sword. The target can’t be raised from the dead until Frostmourne is destroyed.

Pawn of the Lich King. While you’re attuned to Frostmourne, the Lich King can see through your eyes, hear through your ears, and communicate with you telepathically over any distance, even across planes.

Prophecy of Frostmourne. When you attune to Frostmourne, your creature type becomes Undead, and your alignment becomes Neutral Evil. These changes remain even if your Attunement ends.

Twisted Aura. If you are a Paladin, you also gain the following benefits while attuned to Frostmourne:

Marshal Undead. Undead creatures of your choice (excluding you) in your Aura of Protection have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws.

Numb to Cold. Allies in your Aura of Protection have Immunity to Cold damage.

Random Properties. Frostmourne has the following random properties:

  • @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.tables.RollTable.dmgMajorBenefici]{1 major beneficial property}

  • @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.tables.RollTable.dmgMinorDetrimen]{1 minor detrimental property}

  • @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.tables.RollTable.dmgMajorDetrimen]{1 major detrimental property}

Destroying Frostmourne. Frostmourne shatters if its wielder is slain by the legendary sword Ashbringer. Only the Runecarver, who forged the weapon at the Jailer’s command, can reforge Frostmourne from the resulting fragments.

Foundry Note

If attunement ends, drag the separate @UUID[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.effects.ActiveEffect.Jn6OfNf51ibRQfQL]{Prophecy of Frostmourne (Unattuned)} Active Effect from the compendium onto the former wielder’s character sheet. Leave the weapon’s Effect on Frostmourne.

Alchemical Vials.description:
Walden conjures one of the following alchemical mixtures at random (roll [[/r 1d6]]):

1–2: Poisonous Mixture. Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=8bCjM7y0HGwVVzR5]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=8bCjM7y0HGwVVzR5]]-foot-radius [[lookup @target.template.type capitalize activity=8bCjM7y0HGwVVzR5]] centered on a point Walden can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=8bCjM7y0HGwVVzR5]] feet.

After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. While Poisoned, the target takes [[/damage activity activity=hOjzlx8d93muoTS9]] damage at the start of each of its turns.

Success: Half damage only.

3–4: Frost Mixture. Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=rU78DdyWcchp1t5h]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=rU78DdyWcchp1t5h]]-foot-radius [[lookup @target.template.type capitalize activity=rU78DdyWcchp1t5h]] centered on a point Walden can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=rU78DdyWcchp1t5h]] feet.

Failure: [[/damage average activity=rU78DdyWcchp1t5h]] damage, and the target’s Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

Success: Half damage only.

5: Toxic Coagulant. Toxic coagulant fills a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=K79y6PUdz7ACaN2l]]-foot-radius [[lookup @target.template.type capitalize activity=K79y6PUdz7ACaN2l]] centered on a point Walden can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=K79y6PUdz7ACaN2l]] feet for 1 minute or until he dies. The Sphere is Difficult Terrain. A creature that enters the Sphere or starts its turn there is subject to the following effect:

Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=5iFQ7FTTqh5MrVfY]] (a creature makes this save only once per turn).

Failure: [[/damage average activity=5iFQ7FTTqh5MrVfY]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Poisoned apply=false] condition. While a creature is Poisoned by this effect, its Speed decreases by 10 feet. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Each failed save reduces the creature’s Speed by an additional 10 feet.

Success: Half damage only.

Response—Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=bU4LtaI7injuEjU2]], each creature of the moonkin’s choice in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=bU4LtaI7injuEjU2]]-foot Emanation originating from the moonkin.

4J0NOGZdMXYJfvug.name: Moonbeam
4J0NOGZdMXYJfvug.description:
A silvery beam of pale light shines down in a 5-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point within range. Until the spell ends, Dim Light fills the Cylinder, and you can take a Magic action on later turns to move the Cylinder up to 60 feet.

When the Cylinder appears, each creature in it makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d10 Radiant damage, and if the creature is shape-shifted (as a result of the Polymorph spell, for example), it reverts to its true form and can’t shape-shift until it leaves the Cylinder. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. A creature also makes this save when the spell’s area moves into its space and when it enters the spell’s area or ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 2.

Create or Destroy Water.name: Create or Destroy Water
Create or Destroy Water.description:
You do one of the following:

Create Water. You create up to 10 gallons of clean water within range in an open container. Alternatively, the water falls as rain in a 30-foot Cube within range, extinguishing exposed flames there.

Destroy Water. You destroy up to 10 gallons of water in an open container within range. Alternatively, you destroy fog in a 30-foot Cube within range.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You create or destroy 10 additional gallons of water, or the size of the Cube increases by 5 feet, for each spell slot level above 1.

Control Water.name: Control Water
Control Water.description:
Until the spell ends, you control any water inside an area you choose that is a Cube up to 100 feet on a side, using one of the following effects. As a Magic action on your later turns, you can repeat the same effect or choose a different one.

Flood. You cause the water level of all standing water in the area to rise by as much as 20 feet. If you choose an area in a large body of water, you instead create a 20-foot tall wave that travels from one side of the area to the other and then crashes. Any Huge or smaller vehicles in the wave’s path are carried with it to the other side. Any Huge or smaller vehicles struck by the wave have a [[/r 1d100cs<26#Vehicle is capsized]]{25 percent} chance of capsizing.

The water level remains elevated until the spell ends or you choose a different effect. If this effect produced a wave, the wave repeats on the start of your next turn while the flood effect lasts.

Part Water. You part water in the area and create a trench. The trench extends across the spell’s area, and the separated water forms a wall to either side. The trench remains until the spell ends or you choose a different effect. The water then slowly fills in the trench over the course of the next round until the normal water level is restored.

Redirect Flow. You cause flowing water in the area to move in a direction you choose, even if the water has to flow over obstacles, up walls, or in other unlikely directions. The water in the area moves as you direct it, but once it moves beyond the spell’s area, it resumes its flow based on the terrain. The water continues to move in the direction you chose until the spell ends or you choose a different effect.

Whirlpool. You cause a whirlpool to form in the center of the area, which must be at least 50 feet square and 25 feet deep. The whirlpool lasts until you choose a different effect or the spell ends. The whirlpool is 5 feet wide at the base, up to 50 feet wide at the top, and 25 feet tall. Any creature in the water and within 25 feet of the whirlpool is pulled 10 feet toward it. When a creature enters the whirlpool for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, it makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 2d8 Bludgeoning damage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage. A creature can swim away from the whirlpool only if it first takes an action to pull away and succeeds on a [[/check ability=str skill=ath dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] check against your spell save DC.

Tree Stride.name: Tree Stride
Tree Stride.description:
You gain the ability to enter a tree and move from inside it to inside another tree of the same kind within 500 feet. Both trees must be living and at least the same size as you. You must use 5 feet of movement to enter a tree. You instantly know the location of all other trees of the same kind within 500 feet and, as part of the move used to enter the tree, can either pass into one of those trees or step out of the tree you’re in. You appear in a spot of your choice within 5 feet of the destination tree, using another 5 feet of movement. If you have no movement left, you appear within 5 feet of the tree you entered.

You can use this transportation ability only once on each of your turns. You must end each turn outside a tree.

Druidcraft.name: Druidcraft
Druidcraft.description:
Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create one of the following effects within range.

Weather Sensor. You create a Tiny, harmless sensory effect that predicts what the weather will be at your location for the next 24 hours. The effect might manifest as a golden orb for clear skies, a cloud for rain, falling snowflakes for snow, and so on. This effect persists for 1 round.

Bloom. You instantly make a flower blossom, a seed pod open, or a leaf bud bloom.

Sensory Effect. You create a harmless sensory effect, such as falling leaves, spectral dancing fairies, a gentle breeze, the sound of an animal, or the faint odor of skunk. The effect must fit in a 5-foot Cube.

Fire Play. You light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a campfire.

Wand.description: An @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbagArcaneFocus]{Arcane Focus} is bejeweled or carved to channel arcane magic. A Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard can use such an item as a Spellcasting Focus.

Protective Magic.description: [[lookup @name]] casts [[/item .khnrIyw3qETDrjRh]]{Counterspell} or [[/item .3ex6y2qrqvMkWLb6]]{Shield} in response to the spell’s trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

[[lookup @name]] casts one of the following spells, using [[lookup @attributes.spell.abilityLabel]] as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]):
